plans.thesis: The audit's two verdicts point in opposite directions and the gap between them is entirely the document: technically the platform already wins (0 contradicted of 779 checkable figures, 259/259 citations verified, 3,335 calculation rows replayed, £7.19 a run against £10), and practically it lost 51 of 54 dimension votes across nine blind comparisons, with `would_act_on_it` answering "no" 9 of 9 against the console's "with reservations" 9 of 9 (judges/reads.json, recomputed). An unimpeachable evidence base that nobody will act on is not a partial success; it is the product failing at the one job CLAUDE.md sets it — "one institutional-style research report at a time". So this plan is organised around a single idea: **make the document worth reading, in the order a reader meets its failures, and treat the journey defects as what you fix while the live runs that measure the document are in flight.** The order inside that idea is forced by the record rather than chosen — the sections that argue the view are starved of the valuation by one SQL clause (`sections/evidence.py:580-588` against `calc/engine.py:165-169`), so no view can be argued; a document that argues a view while contradicting itself and publishing severity-5 accusations against its own headline numbers is worse than one that says nothing (7 of 9 and 8 of 9 decisive fields say so); a view with no price to sit against cannot be acted on (8 of 9); and the figures a note is read for — a multiple, a segment line, guidance, a bear case with a number — are absent because of wiring gaps, not because an invariant forbids them. The user-ready work waits behind this for three reasons stated plainly below, the strongest being that **every ISSUE-2 fix is measurable only by a live run, and every live run is a full six-gate walk** — so the journey defects are met, diagnosed and fixed on runs already being paid for, by the person who is going to fix them, instead of being inventoried in advance against a document nobody would act on anyway.

workstreams.name: W1 — Open the keyhole: the writers can see the run's own record
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the keystone and it is one session of already-written code. `gather_evidence` selects calculations `ORDER BY period_end DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40` (sections/evidence.py:580-588) while every DCF output carries `period = None` by design (calc/engine.py:165-169), so on azn2's 831 calculation rows the Executive Summary was dealt 9 calculations, 12 facts and 1 excerpt and none of them was the valuation. That is why msft1/report.md:46 says "no valuation output, no discount rate and no peer multiple" eleven lines under a front page printing WACC 9.3% and Value per share $485.29. It is F-27's defect one layer over, and F-27's fix is already written, reviewed and tested at services/red_team.py:330-374. Until it lands, every other document item in this plan is worth less, because the two sections a reader opens for the view are arguing from an evidence pack that excludes the answer.
items: view/writers-never-see-the-valuation — port the red-team index verbatim into `gather_evidence`: order by name then newest period, one row per (name, case), skip SENSITIVITY_CASE, carry the period on every entry, bound calculations separately from facts at a cap sized to the ~60 distinct figures a run computes

prose/sections-are-blind-to-the-record — add a front-page floor: the figures the At-a-glance block prints are present in every section's pack before the ranked remainder, so no section can contradict the front page of its own document

view/valuation-range-columns-never-filled — fill `valuation_low/base/high/currency` in `_render` by extracting `history.py:_current_valuation`'s read into a shared function; the shared read must cover `residual_income_per_share` under `TerminalTreatment` as well as `value_per_share` under `TerminalMethod`, or every bank writes nothing

judges/headline-figures-unlabelled-and-unreconciled — tag per-share rows by terminal method and case so `_headline` (render/glance.py:354-360, which admits any row whose case is absent) can no longer pick the football-field maximum; the front page shows the base method, named, with its period, or both methods when they diverge past a threshold

view/report-promises-a-view-it-never-records — replace the two hardcoded "Recorded at this run's approval." strings (services/history.py:643-661) with the run's own composed figures, and bound `_trim` (history.py:777-781) to significant figures so "169.798802002887 to 333.476013557285 USD/shares" stops reaching a shareable surface

The front-page per-share figure equals one of the valuation section's own outputs, names its method and carries a period. `valuation_low/base/high` are non-null on a re-render of msft1 and of mtb.

workstreams.name: W2 — One document, one story: reconciliation and an adversary that stops lying
workstreams.whyItMatters: Every judge who read a platform report found it saying two incompatible things about a load-bearing figure and found it shipping unresolved severity-5 accusations against its own margins, coverage and leverage. msft1's operator judge, in the decisive field: "A reader with money at stake is told, by the document itself, not to trust its headline numbers." azn2's reader: "I cannot trust a single headline number in A on A's own account." Six of azn2's eight challenges rested on the adversary comparing FY2025 draft figures against FY2021/FY2022 calculations of the same name — arithmetic this repository already forbids in code for facts (services/consistency.py:1-21, written after the red team found exactly this class on a live AAPL report) and never extended to calculations. Those false challenges then bought seven redrafts at £1.22 and ten minutes, which is how the published body came to both assert and disclaim interest cover of 8.11x. A stated view published inside a self-contradicting document is worth nothing, which is why this precedes the view rather than following it.
items: judges/contradiction-and-self-accusation — extend services/consistency.py from FinancialFacts to Calculation rows and to a negative-assertion scan over the assembled draft; render the existing `settle_by_hand` outcome instead of the literal "Escalated for human decision at approval." (sections/deterministic.py:325); refuse FINAL approval while any Disagreement has resolution=escalated. The refusal goes through the gate's evidence rule, NOT through eval/metrics.py — `_validate`'s own docstring is "scores, never a pause" (vertical_slice_v1.py:1658) and msft2 reached AWAITING_APPROVAL with presentation_integrity failing

workstreams.name: W3 — The anchor: a price reaches the page
workstreams.whyItMatters: Eight of nine comparisons name this in the decisive field. azn2's reader: "A prints no share price at all — I grepped; there is none — so its outputs of $169.80 and $333.48 cannot be compared to anything." The knock-on is worse than the omission: with no market capitalisation reaching the WACC, the DCF discounts at book-value weights, and the report's own Recorded Caveats say so — "the equity weight is understated... Every valuation discounted at it is correspondingly too high." Two judges praised that caveat as the document's strongest paragraph and then declined to use the valuation it discredits. The run already acquires the price series; it is in the Sources table on both runs and appears in no figure. And two of five runs lost the entire price layer to a count of the wrong thing: `_record_listing` returns `bars=stored.inserted` (price_acquisition.py:477), discarding `already_held`, so a second run of the same symbol on the same day reports "the provider returned no prices" when the provider returned prices and the platform already held them.
items: comps/no-new-bars-reads-as-no-prices — test `adjusted_series_for(...).bars` rather than the insert count, which is the precondition every downstream figure actually has; fix the peer path at price_acquisition.py:337 identically; leave the market-proxy listing alone, which is not gated on bars==0 and is why azn still regressed a beta

comps/wacc-uses-book-equity-even-with-a-market-cap-in-hand — thread the price step's market capitalisation into `_cost_of_capital` via `_market_capitalisation_from` (vertical_slice_v1.py:1637-1655), which already re-sources the figure to its calculation; prefer MARKET, fall back to BOOK with the existing caveat; re-strike the football field and the comps band in the same pass or the front page and the grid disagree

judges/no-price-no-position — make market capitalisation, enterprise value and the implied upside or downside against each per-share output first-class traced calculations, rendered in the glance block and the valuation section; state the share basis on every per-share row (F-28, §8 item 3)

comps/market-cap-has-no-working-share-count-fallback — settle the filed-count query with one offline SELECT before writing code (four live predicates: dimension_axis, unit=="shares", the point-in-time filed_date clause, the collision dedupe); add a traced `shares_from_earnings` derivation as last resort with its basis stated on the row; retire the `/api/fundamentals` call, which costs ten weighted units to fail against a feed the subscription does not include

workstreams.exitCriterion: A re-run of AZN states a market capitalisation and an enterprise value, the WACC row reads "market values" rather than "book values — this run holds no market prices", the valuation section prints an implied up/downside for each terminal method against a stated share basis, and the report carries no caveat saying its own valuation is too high. A second consecutive run of the same subject on the same day records a market capitalisation (regression test asserts `bars` counts rows held at or before the as-of date). Re-judged: no judge's `first_thing_to_check` is the share basis or the missing price, and no decisive field says the outputs "cannot be compared to anything".

workstreams.name: W4 — The view: stated, owned, and non-binding
workstreams.whyItMatters: Every report the platform has produced says "Non-binding view: no view reached" at line 8, on every surface, because `report.rating = None` is assigned unconditionally at vertical_slice_v1.py:3765 and is the only line in `src/` that writes the column. It reads as an honest abstention after deliberation; it is a literal `None`. The record also shows precisely how much this alone buys: azn2 scored `view_stated` true 3/3 and `argued` true 3/3 — the Investment Thesis does state and argue a view — while the header six lines from the top still denied it, and all three judges still said no. So this item is necessary and provably insufficient, which is exactly why it sits fourth in this plan rather than first, behind the keyhole, the reconciliation and the anchor that make a view defensible. The compliant answer is not a rating the platform produces: `rating`, `recommendation`, `target_price` and `fair_value` are the first entries in RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS (core/schemas/skill.py:73-91), and permitting a model-written label through the built-in door while refusing it through the skill door would make invariant 7 a statement about file formats. The answer is the operator's own view, held at approval, with a holder, a time, a basis that cannot be blank and a falsifier list — which is what a personal research journal is, and what ADR 0074 explicitly permits a Judgement to be displayed as.
items: view/rating-is-hardcoded-null + journey/no-view-ever-stated + prose/no-stated-view-exists + roadmap/stated-view-has-no-roadmap-item — one change, four diagnosis ids: the final gate takes the operator's view and a mandatory basis, stored through `services/theses.py` with the report id (ADR 0102's judgements supertype), mirrored to `reports.rating` for display. "Segment revenue for the latest fiscal year" and "competitive position with named competitors" are scored `absent` in 7 of 7 platform reads; the run holds eight operator-confirmed peer names with CIKs and written rationales and prints none of them.

workstreams.name: W6 — The evidence in the file: verifiability that survives export
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the most surprising result in the record and the one the platform should have won outright: 259 of 259 citations verified, every artefact hashed, every calculation re-executable — and the platform won verifiability in none of the nine comparisons (console 6, equal 3), with checking measurably slower (10-30 minutes against 10-15). msft1's reader judge names the reason exactly: "A's provenance apparatus is better in kind — hashes, formulas, code versions, tiers, point-in-time — while B's is better in practice: nearly every B figure is reproducible from the tables it prints." The cause is that the renderer's footnote builder carries strictly less than the database holds: `_footnotes` (render/document.py:740-800) emits a SourceFootnote of title, url, publisher and tier and no excerpt and no locator, though `citations.excerpt` is stored and is the very thing `aer.verify.citations` re-reads; and a CalculationFootnote with no inputs, though `Calculation.inputs` is a JSONB array whose module docstring says a calculation without its inputs "is not a partial record, it is an unusable one". Nothing here touches an invariant — it is the opposite: it makes invariants 1, 2 and 3 legible to the person the report is for.
items: judges/verifiability-lost-in-the-export + journey/exported-footnote-has-no-excerpt — extend SourceFootnote with the verified excerpt and its locator (for an XBRL fact: concept, period, unit; for a filing: item and quoted sentence) and CalculationFootnote with its inputs by name, value, unit and their own markers. The metadata already exists: sections/render.py:86 carries `financial_fact_id` and `extraction_id` on the fragment items as hidden provenance, so the fact footnote can be given the concept and period from FinancialFact and the excerpt from Extraction with no new plumbing in the writer

A document citing one source forty times renders one note and forty markers. The Markdown edition of a report with a segment exhibit contains each member label and each value. A replayed 8-K accession records two T1 documents and excerpts for both. Re-judged: `minutes_to_check_three_figures` falls to 10 or below in at least 2 of 3 reads and below the console's figure on the same subject; `better_on_verifiability` returns platform in at least 4 of 6 comparisons; no judge's verifiability note says a figure "cannot be located".

workstreams.name: W7 — The prose argues, and answers the question it was asked
workstreams.whyItMatters: Across 27 focus-question readings of platform documents the judges recorded 1 yes, 17 partly and 9 no; across the same 27 for the console, 6 yes, 21 partly and 0 no. The console labels its sections against the brief — "The patent-cliff question (part 2 of 3 posed in the brief)" — and answers each with arithmetic it shows. `ResearchRequest.focus_questions` reaches exactly two consumers in `src/`: the planner's user turn and the plan critic's. It reaches no section writer, no researcher, no red team, no validator, and no metric asks whether the document answers the questions it was commissioned to answer. Underneath that, the deterministic layer computes levels and almost no movements: `aer/calc/bridge.py` — a margin decomposition, unit- and mutation-tested — has zero production callers, there is no contribution-to-growth and no market-implied solve, and prompt rule 1 correctly forbids the writer deriving any of them. So the one thing the console won on, decomposition, is unavailable to the platform by construction rather than by rule, and wiring it moves arithmetic into the only place CLAUDE.md allows it to be.
items: judges/brief-never-travels-past-the-planner + evidence-policy/workers-never-see-the-focus-questions — compose the operator's focus questions verbatim into every section writer's and every research worker's user turn, in the trusted half beside the topic brief (they are request fields the operator typed, not skill text); add a deterministic "Answers to your questions" block near the front, one entry per question, each naming the sections that bear on it and each carrying at least one cited figure — the emitter refuses an entry with no cited figure rather than emitting it empty; add `brief_coverage` as a gate-2 display, with the refusal in the emitter, not the metric

prose/analysis-computes-levels-never-movements — wire `margin_bridge` into the analysis pass over consecutive annual periods (already written and mutation-hardened; the caller and the section's evidence preference are the whole job), then add a contribution-to-growth decomposition with its residual shown. Gate the market-implied reverse solve on W3 settling why the valuation could not reach a market capitalisation the run held

judges/scenario-engine-has-no-production-caller — wire the scenario step between the assumptions gate and the valuation: propose bear/base/bull as assumption overrides at the gate the operator already answers, resolve each as a diff, run the valuation under each, render outputs with the overridden inputs named. The machinery is complete and unwired — `create_scenario` and `set_override` have no caller anywhere in `src/`. Settle §8 item 8 and print it on the row

prose/no-synthesis-pass — make the synthesis a second wave of the draft step: the two one-pager sections plus `investment_thesis` draft after the analytical sections, with the drafted sections' own recorded claims in their pack, and may restate a figure only by naming a claim id that already carries its lineage. Add a closing section as a seeded definition row. Confirm the wave ordering survives the resume path, which keeps already-generated sections

prose/gap-rule-catches-phrasing-not-behaviour — a declared "What this section could not establish" field on every section's contract, rendered once at the end, with absence forbidden in the body; the phrase budget becomes a measurement rather than a refusal. `_GAP_PHRASES` catches ~1% of the prose while ~8-10% is about absence, and it costs paid retries to catch nothing

judges/sections-write-about-the-evidence-not-the-company — scale a section's drafting budget to its evidence as a second axis on the existing depth scaling; extend the process-language register to catch researcher-directed advice ("register search", "should not be limited to"); distinguish "the issuer does not disclose this" from "this run did not retrieve it" by giving the writer the list of documents the run selected and did not fetch. The wording fix must reach the `requires_primary` banner text too, which is a policy refusal rather than a writer choice

prose/numeral-rule-refuses-argument-carrying-sentences — extend the erasers (never the exemptions): a hyphenated alphanumeric designator pattern for `FPI-2059`, and a bounded run of intervening words between an existing temporal anchor and a year for "by the end of 2030". 16 of 27 refusals across three runs were the numeral rule refusing product codes and disclosed dates, which teaches the writer to avoid naming specifics — the exact habit that makes prose recite

prose/salvage-decapitates-and-deparagraphs — preserve the separator so a salvaged field keeps its paragraphs, and stop cutting the last sentence of the longest field, which in a research paragraph is the conclusion. Give the "prefer a sentence with no numeral and no causal connective" rule an explicit fallback, or the trim loop does not terminate

prose/word-budgets-uniform-and-the-experiment-unanswered — answer migration 0045's experiment with the measured result (overruns rescaled 1.46→~1.29, so `target_words` binds only partially), make the stated ceiling and the enforced ceiling the same number, and reallocate by argument load. Do this last, after the packs are full, or the reallocation is calibrated on the wrong document
workstreams.exitCriterion: On the verdict round, at least one focus question per document scores `yes` from at least two of three lenses and no question scores `no` from any lens (September: 1 yes, 17 partly, 9 no across 27). The published report contains an entry per focus question, each carrying a resolvable footnote. A live MSFT run's Earnings Quality or Historical Financial Analysis contains a sentence of the form "operating margin moved N basis points, of which X was gross margin and Y was operating expenses", every numeral footnoted to a recorded calculation and re-executed by `aer replay-run` with zero divergence. The report prints a bear, base and bull value per share with the inputs changed for each, and the bear value sits below the base. Every section's limitation appears exactly once, in the declared field.

workstreams.name: W8 — The journey, fixed while the runs are in flight
workstreams.whyItMatters: This plan commissions six live runs and several replays; every one is a full commission-to-approval walk through six or seven gates, and the states that strand an operator are exactly the states a programme of re-runs hits. Two of them are not deferrable, because they block the programme itself: a stale approval has no exit (the run resumes, finds the payload has moved, and the gate page says "A decision is not a state to re-assert; changing it needs a new run" with no form on it), and a run refused at gate 2 can be re-measured nowhere and cannot even be superseded, because a rejected gate leaves the job AWAITING_APPROVAL, which is not terminal. A document-first programme changes things and re-runs, which is precisely what strands a run — so these are tooling, taken first, and the rest is fixed on evidence as the runs meet it rather than from an inventory built in advance.
items: journey/stale-approval-dead-end — PROGRAMME PREREQUISITE. Close the door (refuse an amend or create against a request whose ASSUMPTIONS gate is decided, reusing `gates.refuse_settling_after_decision`'s shape; hide the forms as the theme and peer pages already do) and open the exit (a superseding `Decision.AMENDED` against the live payload, admitted only when the recorded approval matches neither the seal nor the live page). The ADR must say what a superseding decision does to the seal

journey/refused-check-no-remeasure + journey/terminal-still-required (re-seal half) — PROGRAMME PREREQUISITE. A "Score this run again" action that invalidates the `validate` step row, appends an audit event and re-enqueues; a re-seal action on the gate page for the exact state its own message describes, which removes the last CLI reference from user-facing prose; treat a REJECTED gate as superseding-eligible. Note `evaluate_run` documents replace-not-append for evaluation rows — either keep that and change the test, or say in the ADR why history is now wanted

journey/decided-gate-still-says-waiting — `pending_gate` returns None when the named gate carries a decision, and the console gains a third state naming the decision, its date and the two things actually available. Six callers, including the JSON API contract, so this is half a session rather than an hour

journey/developer-vocabulary-everywhere + roadmap/report-readability-2-9-needs-reopening — move `METRIC_WORDS` and the tier words out of `aer.web.vocabulary` into a neutral module both the renderer and the interface import (the reader-facing names already exist, keyed by metric value, with a test walking `Metric`); render scores through the house-style door rather than `str(Decimal)`; translate the tier; extend `presentation_integrity` to fail on a bare metric identifier and an unformatted decimal in reader prose

journey/server-error-is-json — negotiate on Accept so an HTML request gets the problem page with the request id and a link back to the run; name the worker log and the run console rather than an absent support desk; add one browser test per gate against a multi-period filing fixture, which is what stops the next F-10

journey/citation-override-on-no-surface — build the per-citation override form ADR 0018 already decided, including that there is no bulk action; today the gate message promises a control that exists on no page and an unverified citation has no recovery

journey/enqueue-failure-is-silent — carry the enqueue failure into the redirect; make the console's queued line honest when Redis is unreachable rather than falling through to "the worker picks this up within a second or two"

journey/unmapped-gate-unanswerable — lead with the rows that could change an answer (the payload already carries each tag's share of the biggest mapped line), collapse the rest behind one disclosure with its count, and let the operator mark a tag for the existing curation queue. The approved hash still covers every row. Account for `payload.refused_concepts`, which the page also renders

journey/assumptions-hand-typed-every-run — wire the macro client into the run (built, licence-cleared, and constructed nowhere in `src/`) and propose the risk-free rate as a derived assumption carrying its series key, observation date and vintage; give the equity risk premium a standing operator value in settings, re-proposed and re-confirmed every run. Read ADR 0082 and 0084 first — the acquisition shape may already be decided. The standing value must NOT be stored as a macro observation

speed/revise-runs-one-section-at-a-time — fan revise out at the bound draft already uses; it is 10.1-11.3 minutes of every run and provably serial (step duration equals the sum of its own call latencies to within a second on all three exported runs). Worth doing because this programme pays for six runs and several replays

speed/first-read-surfaces-exist-and-are-unreachable + speed/the-numbers-are-ready-at-eight-minutes — link `/runs/{id}/summary` and `/runs/{id}/preview` from the console while a run is RUNNING, under an honest heading, with no approval control, and fix the PENDING status line. Both routes already render from live rows; `/summary` is registered and linked from no template at all

speed/the-runtime-estimate-at-gate-one-counts-the-research-wave-five-times — merge the intervals rather than summing them, and render in words. Correct audit/scoring/platform_report.py in the same change, and re-state §4.2's 31-42 minutes as 26.5-36.8

uk/uk-request-dead-end + uk/uk-refusal-misreads-the-adr-route + uk/uk-claims-in-developer-docs — stop selling the dead end: refuse an LSE request at creation with a message naming the US-listing route (keeping `SUPPORTED_EXCHANGES` intact so a London holding stays watchable and dealable), pass the requested company name into resolution so AstraZeneca is not told it is "a different company", and correct knowledge-map.md:82 and :171 plus the `Company.sic` claim at vertical_slice_v1.py:2322. Note `audit/smoke.py:120-148` asserts the LSE run FAILS and must move to asserting a clean refusal

NEW: a dead-end inventory kept as a living table, one row per state a run can stop in, derived from the console templates as well as from §5 — including the failed-step fallback that reads "The worker terminal holds the full record" and the `remedy` branch that deliberately offers no forward control. Each live run in this programme is walked against it and the table is updated
workstreams.exitCriterion: The journey harness reports zero stopped states with no labelled forward control in the browser; a grep of every user-facing template and every StepPaused message finds no shell command; zero UUIDs and zero unledgered snake_case identifiers in visible page text across every page a run visits; the MTB document re-assembled from its own record carries no metric key and no raw Decimal in reader prose with `presentation_integrity` at 0; all three judged runs in the verdict round reach an approved, rendered report with no terminal use and no rescue (September: 3 of 6).
workstreams.effort: 8 sessions, spread between the live runs

workstreams.name: W9 — The instrument: measure it the same way twice
workstreams.whyItMatters: The finding this whole plan answers — nine of nine blind comparisons choosing the console — came from eighteen agent reads and nine comparisons under a fixed rubric, and none of that is code. It exists in the repository only as its output, `judges/reads.json`. A repeat would rebuild the rubric by hand, and any drift in a key's wording silently changes what the new round measures at exactly the moment the operator needs the two rounds compared. Worse, the blind was never verified: the judged paths were `.../audit/out/baseline/msft1/note.md` against `.../audit/out/msft1/report.md`, so the console side sits in a directory named `baseline` and nothing records whether a judge saw it. ISSUE 1 has no instrument at all — gate stops and terminal escapes were counted by hand, and the recorded "gate waits" are the driver's polling intervals rather than a person's minutes.
items: measure/judging-harness-is-not-in-the-repository — build `audit/judging/` with the rubric lifted verbatim from reads.json as data (fourteen read keys, nine comparison keys, ten checklist items, three lenses); serve both documents from identically shaped neutral paths (A.md, B.md under one directory) before any judge sees a path; randomise the A/B assignment from a recorded seed; write the unblinding key to the harness's own file, never into a prompt; pin the model, effort and agent shape, and record that September's is unrecorded

measure/the-blind-is-nominal-so-record-the-guess — add one rubric key, `which_was_machine_assembled_and_how_you_knew`, and report the hit rate beside the verdict; strip the console note's chat preamble as a declared normalisation of one side; report a round where judges guess correctly 8 or 9 of 9 as format-confounded rather than as a clean verdict

measure/journey-harness-on-the-fake-scene + measure/dead-end-inventory-is-the-issue-1-test — extend `audit/smoke.py` to call `drive(..., screenshots=True)` on the fake scene for the shape numbers the per-page records already carry (gate stops, values supplied, UUIDs, raw tokens, approve controls), and add `tests/e2e/journey.py` for the click-level half only (a labelled forward control on each stopped state, operator actions counted front page to rendered report). The harness must fail before the fixes; a harness green on its first run is measuring nothing

measure/issue-2-remeasurement-plan + measure/pre-registered-targets + measure/baselines-reusable-but-the-as-of-cannot-be-pinned — commit the protocol document, with the targets and the September value beside each, at a hash that predates the first paid run; reuse all three September console notes and state the staleness asymmetry (a stale console note is a lower bound on the console, so a platform loss against it is conclusive and needs no control); buy one fresh MSFT note only if the platform wins

measure/promote-the-filing-agreement-matcher-advisory — move numerals/facts/match into `src/aer/eval/` (pure classification) with the artefact read in the service layer, registered advisory in `services/evaluations.py` beside the other eleven, shipped with a mutation corpus that proves it can fail. Budget the ruff/mypy migration of 1,284 exempted lines honestly — it is most of the work

measure/promote-the-completeness-readout — a deterministic coverage readout of the nine headline figures, present or withheld with a reason in a reader's words, built from the run's own rows rather than from substring matches over prose (the September scorer scores azn2 `market_capitalisation: true` off the sentence "no market capitalisation was available"). A readout, never a gate: ADR 0066 settled that withholding can be the right answer

measure/a-reader-verifiability-metric — count distinct citation targets and the share of evidence footnotes whose target is a machine endpoint rather than a page a person can read, plus the share openable at all. msft1's 142 footnotes resolve to four distinct URLs, 40 of them the same companyfacts JSON and one an EODHD API call with its token redacted, which nobody can open

measure/variance-scorer-stays-on-demand — keep it in `audit/` and say so in the protocol; add the category that separates a confirmed-assumption difference from an arithmetic one, and run it over the verdict round's MSFT pair, which the round already commissions

measure/minutes-are-measured-live-not-in-the-harness — rename the gate-wait field to say it is the driver's, and define one clock number, "commission to first readable artefact", computed from step timestamps on the live runs the round already pays for

NEW: the protocol asserts the round's absolute budget against a ledger reading taken at its own commit, and records judging spend through `Ledger.record(kind="other", label="judging")` — September's judges were paid in session tokens and are off-ledger by construction
workstreams.exitCriterion: A committed protocol document, dated before the first paid run, naming the subjects, the run count, the baseline reuse decision, the judge count and every threshold with its September value beside it. `uv run python -m audit.judging.read <doc> --lens sceptic` reproduces the September shape on a committed report and a diff of the key sets is empty. The journey harness fails on today's tree and goes green row by row as the fixes land. Every completed run writes a `filing_agreement` row and a coverage readout.

order.what: W1 in full — open the keyhole. Port F-27's evidence fix into `gather_evidence`, add the front-page floor, fill the valuation range columns (including the bank's `residual_income_per_share` branch), tag per-share rows by method and case, bound `_trim`'s precision, and make the prior-research comparison state figures instead of promising them.
order.why: Every other document item is worth less until the two sections a reader opens for the view can see the valuation. It is a port of an already-written, already-tested query, needs no ADR, no decision and no live run, and it is the only item in the plan whose absence invalidates the measurement of everything after it: judging a document whose Executive Summary was structurally starved tells you about the query, not about the writing.
order.gatedOn: nothing
order.liveRuns: none — verified by `aer rehearse-section` over an archived job (pennies) and by re-rendering msft1 and mtb from stored rows

order.what: W8's two programme prerequisites plus W9's instrument. The superseding decision at a stale gate, the re-measure and re-seal actions, the decided-gate console state; then `audit/judging/` with neutral paths and the identity-guess key, the smoke-driven shape numbers, the standing ADR-0061 scope test, and the three UK honesty edits.
order.why: This is tooling for the programme, not user-ready work done early. A document-first plan changes things and re-runs, which is exactly what strands a run at a moved payload or a refused check — the two states with no exit today. Building the judging harness now, before the first paid judgement, is what makes the steer at step 7 and the verdict at step 12 the same instrument. The scope test lands before any evidence-widening item so it is what fails first if W5 or W6 reopens ADR 0061's cross-issuer contamination.
order.gatedOn: ADR 12 (superseding decision) drafted and accepted
order.liveRuns: none — the judging harness is exercised against the committed September reports; the shape numbers come from the fake scene at £0

order.what: W2's reconciliation half. Extend `services/consistency.py` to Calculation rows and to negative assertions over the frozen assembled draft; write the operator's settlement back and render it; refuse FINAL while any disagreement is escalated; refill the appendix inside the settle path. Ship the cross-section check as a gate-2 report first, not a refusal.
order.why: Before the document states a view it must stop contradicting itself, because a view inside a self-contradicting document is worse than no view: it gives the reader a specific thing to disbelieve. This is where 7 of 9 and 8 of 9 decisive fields point, and it is also the check that makes W4's "the header may never contradict the thesis" enforceable rather than aspirational.
order.gatedOn: step 1 (the check needs the writers to have seen the figures, or it fires on every run at once); ADR 1
order.liveRuns: none — regression tests build the contradicting documents directly

order.what: W2's adversary half. Period adjudication in code, materiality gated on a surviving premise, the fact index widened, the appendix split, one footnote per cited id, the coverage note published, and the run-level metrics re-measured inside `revise` before the seal.
order.why: Here rather than earlier because it depends on the adjudicator the reconciliation pass makes cheap, and earlier than the view because the appendix is the second-longest section in the document and is the platform accusing its own headline numbers. Before writing the adjudicator, replay `_evidence_index` over azn2's stored calculations under current code and count how many of the five figure-citing challenges can still be constructed post-F-27 — a free offline read that decides whether this is a session well spent or a closed hole.
order.gatedOn: step 3; ADR 8
order.liveRuns: none — one offline replay of azn2's stored rows, £0

order.what: W3 in full — the anchor. Fix the bars count, prefer market equity in the WACC, make market capitalisation, enterprise value and implied up/downside first-class traced calculations in the glance block and the valuation section, state the share basis on every per-share row, and settle the filed share-count query with one offline SELECT before writing any derivation.
order.why: A view needs something to be a view about. Eight of nine comparisons say the per-share outputs cannot be compared to anything, and the report currently tells its own reader that its discount rate is too low for a reason untrue of the run. Before the view rather than after it, so the view the operator states at step 6 has a price to sit against on the day it first appears.
order.gatedOn: operator decision 2 (ADR 0030 route 2 amendment). If the operator answers 'keep withholding', this step shrinks to the bars fix and the market-value WACC, and ISSUE 2 acquires a ceiling that the rest of the plan cannot clear — say so out loud rather than proceeding quietly
order.liveRuns: none — replayed price fixtures and a re-valuation of msft1's stored assumptions

order.what: W4 in full — the view. The operator states it at the final gate, prefilled from the thesis section; the header renders it; the thesis gains its augmenter's `build` and `note` and a required falsifier list; the one-pager carries the thesis; `confidence` is retired from every render branch.
order.why: Fourth, not first, and deliberately. The record proves a stated view alone changes nothing: azn2 scored view_stated 3/3 and argued 3/3 and all three judges still said no, because the header denied it, the figures were unanchored and the appendix accused them. With steps 1-5 landed, the view is the last piece of the document's spine rather than a label on a document that cannot support one.
order.gatedOn: steps 1, 3, 5; operator decision 3 (whose view, and in what vocabulary); ADR 2
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: LIVE STEER. Re-run the AZN #2 brief once. Three blind judge reads and three blind comparisons against the September AZN console note, through the step-2 harness. Walk the run against the dead-end inventory and record every stopped state.
order.why: This is the plan's kill-check and it is deliberately cheap. The thesis of a document-first plan is that the spine — record visible, no contradiction, anchored, a view — moves a practitioner's answer. azn2 is the one subject where that thesis has already been half-tested and failed, so it is the honest place to test it again. If the decisive fields still name missing figures rather than the view, the thesis is wrong in its ordering and W5 and W7 move ahead of W6 before another session is spent. Doing this after six offline steps rather than after twenty-five is the whole point of putting it here.
order.liveRuns: AZN ×1 (£8 budgeted against a measured £7.21), plus 3 reads and 3 comparisons (£2.50)
order.gatedOn: steps 1-6; the protocol document committed at a hash predating the run

order.what: W5 in full — the figures a note is read for. Subject multiples reach §17 with footnotes and named peers; segment facts reach the segment section by axis; the segment and revenue exhibits stop vanishing on a second run; the two missing figure guards land. Optional branch: the bank's revenue, withheld at the parse layer then derived.
order.why: After the steer because the steer tells you whether the spine or the content is the binding constraint, and the answer changes what gets six sessions. The guards land here, in the same phase as the new figures rather than after them: the programme is about to publish market capitalisations, enterprise values and multiples, and the scale-word gap is the one hole that can put a thousandfold-wrong number in the sentence a note is read for. The standing scope test from step 2 is what fails first if any of this widens evidence by accident.
order.gatedOn: step 2's scope test; step 7's steer; ADR 4, ADR 5, ADR 14; operator decision 4 if the bank branch is taken (gated on the free offline splice test — FY2021-FY2023 must reconcile exactly, which they do: 3,825+2,167=5,992, 5,822+2,357=8,179, 7,115+2,528=9,643)
order.liveRuns: none — everything here is verified by re-rendering msft1, azn2 and mtb from their own stored rows

order.what: W6 in full — the evidence in the file. The footnote carries its verified excerpt and locator, the calculation footnote carries its inputs, footnotes deduplicate by identity, exhibits export their series as tables, EX-99 exhibits are acquired at T1 with content-aware current-report selection, and worker-fetched pages are excerpted so they can be cited at all.
order.why: After the figures, because there is no point making provenance legible for figures that are not in the document. This is the one dimension where the platform was already ahead in kind and lost 0 of 9 in practice, so it is the cheapest available swing on a measured axis. The exhibit acquisition sits here rather than in W5 because it buys guidance sentences and recent-developments prose — it cannot produce a segment table, and saying so now stops a later session trying.
order.gatedOn: step 8; ADR 6
order.liveRuns: none — replayed accession fixtures and re-renders

order.what: W7's first half — the brief travels and the bear case gets a number. Focus questions into every writing and research role, an answers block that refuses an uncited entry, `brief_coverage` displayed at gate 2, and the scenario step wired into the workflow with operator-confirmed overrides.
order.why: The focus-question result (1 yes in 27 against the console's 6) and the absent bear case are two of the sharpest measured losses, and both are wiring: the questions reach two consumers in `src/`, and `create_scenario` has no caller anywhere. Here rather than earlier because the answers block needs the figures of step 8 and the citations of step 9 to have anything to answer with.
order.gatedOn: steps 8, 9; ADR 9, ADR 11; operator decision 8 (what a scenario holds fixed)
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: W7's second half — the prose argues. Wire `margin_bridge` and add contribution-to-growth; the two-wave draft and a closing section; the declared gap field; the numeral erasers; the salvage fix; evidence-scaled budgets and retrieval-versus-disclosure wording; then reallocate the word budgets against the now-full packs.
order.why: Last of the document work, and deliberately so: prose calibrated against starved evidence packs is calibrated on the wrong document, which is why the word-budget reallocation is explicitly the final item rather than the first. Three to five `aer rehearse-section` runs over archived jobs settle the budget question for a few pounds rather than a live run.
order.gatedOn: steps 1, 8, 10; ADR 10, ADR 13
order.liveRuns: none live; ~£3 of `aer rehearse-section` and one `live_llm` route comparison over archived packs

order.what: THE VERDICT ROUND. Three live runs: MSFT ×2 (the second the next UTC day, which doubles as the refresh use case and gives the run-to-run variance check for free) and AZN ×1. Judge the MSFT and AZN documents against the reused September console notes — 12 reads, 6 comparisons. Run the variance scorer over the MSFT pair. Walk all three against the dead-end inventory. Score against the pre-registered targets and nothing else.
order.why: One round, not three, because the targets were fixed before the work and the temptation after a long programme is to keep measuring until a dimension improves. Every run commissioned inside this window is judged and none is discarded for reading badly — pre-registered.
order.gatedOn: steps 1-11; the protocol committed before step 7 and unamended since
order.liveRuns: MSFT ×2 + AZN ×1 (£24 budgeted against a measured £6.80-£7.61), 12 reads and 6 comparisons (£5)

measurement.target: ISSUE 2 is fixed when, on the verdict round, at least 3 of 6 blind comparisons do NOT choose the console on `better_answers_the_brief` — platform or equal — against 0 of 9 in September, AND the platform is named better on `better_on_verifiability` in at least 4 of 6, against 0 of 9 (6 console, 3 equal). ISSUE 1 is fixed when the journey harness reports zero stopped states with no labelled forward control, zero UUIDs and zero shell commands in visible page text, and all 3 verdict-round runs reach an approved rendered report with no terminal use and no rescue, against 3 of 6 in September. Both numbers are stated here, in a document committed at a hash that predates the first paid run of step 7, with the September value beside each.
measurement.issue1Test: The journey harness (`tests/e2e/journey.py` plus the smoke-driven shape numbers from `audit/smoke.py`, both built at step 2 and both required to FAIL on today's tree) reports, over the fake scene and over each of the four live walks: (a) zero rows of the dead-end inventory without a labelled forward control reachable in the browser — the inventory is derived from the console templates as well as from §5, so it includes the failed-step fallback reading "The worker terminal holds the full record" and the `remedy` branch that offers no control; (b) zero UUIDs and zero unledgered snake_case identifiers in visible page text across every page a run visits (the ledger of permitted identifiers is written as part of the harness, or the count is not scoreable); (c) zero pages whose visible text names a shell command — a grep of every template and every StepPaused message, against September's console naming `just worker` and a pause message naming `aer reseal`; (d) 3 of 3 verdict-round runs reach an approved, rendered report with no terminal use and no rescue, against September's 3 of 6; (e) the MTB document re-assembled from its own record contains no snake_case metric identifier and no raw Decimal in reader prose, with `presentation_integrity` at 0 failures. Thresholds, each against its measured September value (recomputed from reads.json, not quoted from prose): (1) `better_answers_the_brief` platform-or-equal ≥ 3 of 6 [Sept 0 of 9]; (2) `better_on_verifiability` platform ≥ 4 of 6 [Sept 0 of 9; 6 console, 3 equal]; (3) `would_act_on_it` — no platform document draws "no" from all three of its judges, and ≥ 2 of 6 reads answer "with reservations" or better [Sept 0 of 9]; (4) focus questions — every question `yes` or `partly` from 3 of 3, with ≥ 1 outright `yes` per document [Sept 27 platform answers: 1 yes, 17 partly, 9 no; console 6 yes, 21 partly, 0 no]; (5) checklist — `segment revenue breakdown` and `competitive position with named competitors` present in ≥ 2 of 3 reads per document [Sept `absent` 7 of 7 on both]; (6) zero occurrences of "Escalated for human decision" in any published report, and no judge's `first_thing_to_check` naming an internal contradiction or the front-page headline [Sept: all three msft1 judges named the At-a-glance headline; all three azn2 judges named the disagreements log]; (7) `better_argued` platform-or-equal ≥ 2 of 6 [Sept 0 of 9]. A round where judges identify the machine-assembled document 8 or 9 times out of 9 is reported as format-confounded, not as a clean verdict, and the narrower instrument (the three focus-question answers alone, footnote markers stripped) is run as the tie-break. That asymmetry is not symmetric in effect — a stale console note is a LOWER BOUND on the console, so a platform loss against it is conclusive and needs no control. Before judging, confirm from EDGAR's submissions index (through `aer.fetch`, not curl — only `aer.fetch` may make outbound requests) that no new annual or quarterly filing has landed between each baseline's date and the run's; if one has, that subject's baseline is re-bought rather than reused.
