permanentMetrics: figure_agreement_across_sections — the deterministic cross-document figure index from W2, reporting at gate 2 for its first two live runs and promoted to a blocking refusal (through the gate's evidence rule, never through eval/metrics.py) once two consecutive runs are clean

filing_agreement — the audit's numeral matcher against the filed bytes, moved into src/aer/eval/ with the artefact read in the service layer and registered ADVISORY in services/evaluations.py, shipped with a mutation corpus that proves it can fail. It was calibrated to zero on the very reports it would gate and its recall has never been measured; promoting it blocking before the corpus exists would be decorative

brief_coverage — focus questions carrying no cited figure anywhere in the document. Displayed at gate 2; the refusal lives in the answers-block emitter, which can refuse to render an uncited entry, because a metric cannot stop a run
view_stated — advisory: the header carries a view and, where a per-share output exists, an anchor. A cheap permanent guard against the header regressing to a constant

self_consistency_of_absence — computed structurally rather than lexically: the intersection of the concepts the rendered document publishes as figures (the glance rows carry calculation_id) with those a section's claims assert as absent. Needs the declared gap field from W7 first, so it is sequenced after it, not before

a reader-verifiability count — distinct citation targets, the share of evidence footnotes whose target is a machine endpoint, and the share openable at all. The dimension the platform lost 0 of 9 on, with no number to move today

the completeness readout — nine headline figures present or withheld with a reason in a reader's words, built from the run's own rows. A READOUT, never a gate: ADR 0066 settled that withholding can be the right answer, and F-25 is what happens when a check judges the platform's own withheld-figure note

NOT promoted: the run-to-run variance comparison (it needs two runs of one subject, and a difference in a confirmed assumption is the design working); and no model judge at run time — a model scoring a model's prose cannot be replayed deterministically and costs money every run

operatorDecisions: BUDGET, before step 7. This plan spends £43 of live money: £10.50 on the steer, £29 on the verdict round, £3 on section rehearsals. With the bank branch it is £53.50; with one contingency re-steer, £64. The audit's £100 ceiling has £36.68 unspent, and that residue is a property of the current database rather than a durable fact (audit/ledger.py reads the platform half live from the costs table). RECOMMENDATION: approve £55 as a new absolute ceiling, stated in the protocol document and asserted by the ledger at that document's own commit, and record the judging spend through Ledger.record(kind="other") — September's judges were paid in session tokens and are off-ledger by construction.

ADR 0030 ROUTE 2 — WHICH PRICE-DERIVED FIGURES MAY APPEAR IN A SHAREABLE ARTEFACT, before step 5. Options: (a) derived figures only — market capitalisation, enterprise value, multiples, implied up/downside — and no printed close; (b) also a 'Reference price' line with the licence note on its provenance row; (c) keep withholding. RECOMMENDATION: (a), with the honest observation that market capitalisation divided by the filed share count gives the reader the price to two decimals anyway, so (a) and (b) differ in form rather than in what a reader learns; (c) is what produced eight of nine decisive fields. Note plainly: printing a market capitalisation in a shared report is ITSELF the amendment, not a licence-clean move — the open question is not only the raw close. If the answer is (c), say so at step 5 and accept that ISSUE 2 has a ceiling this plan cannot clear.

WHOSE VIEW, AND IN WHAT VOCABULARY, before step 6. Options: (a) the operator states it at the final gate, stored as a judgement under ADR 0102 with a holder, a time and a basis that cannot be blank, rendered as theirs; (b) a `view` role proposes over the frozen draft and the operator confirms; (c) derive it mechanically from value against price, banded; (d) delete the header line. RECOMMENDATION: (a). It is the only option that survives ADR 0074 and RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS without argument, and it is what a personal research journal is. Accept the cost out loud: an unattended run will never state a view, so the platform's document will always say less than a console note unless a person wrote the view. (d) is the honest fallback if (a) is refused — printing a denial is worse than printing nothing — but the record says a document with no conclusion will keep losing.

A BANK'S REVENUE (F-24, the one blocking finding still open), before step 8's optional branch. Options: withhold at the parse layer; derive under a confirmed bank profile; both; leave it. RECOMMENDATION: WITHHOLD FIRST, THEN DERIVE ON TOP — and the ordering is load-bearing rather than stylistic. `analyse_company` builds annual statements only, so a derivation in `aer.calc` can never clear the seven quarterly plausibility findings and therefore can never on its own reach gate 2; withholding at companyfacts.py:199-235 is the one place all six revenue-reading surfaces inherit from, and `acquire` runs before `classify`, so a sector-conditional rule cannot be applied where facts are written. Gate the derivation on the free offline splice: FY2021-FY2023 must reconcile exactly, and they do (3,825+2,167=5,992; 5,822+2,357=8,179; 7,115+2,528=9,643, against reported `Revenues` of 5,992, 8,179 and 9,643). Fix `_figure_scenes`'s `total_assets`→`assets` strings in the same change — the turnover guard has never fired from the gate, and it will add two findings to M&T before the revenue fix removes thirteen.

PEER MULTIPLES (§8 item 1), after step 12 and not before. Options: (a) publish the subject's own multiples now and defer peer acquisition; (b) seed three or four of MSFT's confirmed peers as ordinary subjects then re-run, which needs no code change at all and settles alignment, timing and ADR 0061 containment with real data for £21-30; (c) build in-run acquisition (a few sessions, an ADR 0059 third amendment, and the exact condition ADR 0061 was written to stop). RECOMMENDATION: (a) now, inside step 8, because the figures already exist and are thrown away at the render boundary; then decide between (b) and (c) on the verdict round's evidence of whether `more_complete_against_the_checklist` is still lost. If (b) or (c) is taken, `peer-period-alignment-is-inconsistent`'s correctness half (align on the period the multiple is computed from) ships first as a one-hour bug fix, and foreign private issuers priced as depositary receipts are excluded by name until a receipt ratio is held.

THE TIER CEILING AND NEWS (§8 item 12), after step 12. Options: (a) leave every built-in section at T4 and say on the request form and in the coverage notice that this is a filings instrument; (b) raise to T5 for named outward-facing sections with claim-level tier marking; (c) a per-run operator switch. RECOMMENDATION: LEAVE IT FOR THIS PROGRAMME. It needs worker-fetched pages to be excerptable first (step 9 does that, which is most of the value), a new ADR against ADR 0092 and ADR 0111's recorded/evidence tier split, and claim-level tier marking as a precondition — and the judges docked the console for exactly the sources it would admit (CNN, Robinhood, a Substack, btw.media). Revisit with the verdict round's `better_on_recent_developments` in hand.

WHETHER THE CROSS-SECTION CHECK REFUSES OR REPORTS, at step 3 and again after step 7. RECOMMENDATION: report at gate 2 for its first two live runs, then promote to a refusal through the gate's evidence rule. A new blocking check that fires on every run would strand this programme's own re-runs, which is the failure mode step 2's tooling exists to prevent and should not have to.

WHAT A SCENARIO HOLDS FIXED (§8 item 8), before step 10. Does a scenario overriding beta or the risk-free rate recompute the WACC? RECOMMENDATION: yes, and state the answer on the rendered scenario row. Today a scenario keeps the base WACC while reporting a rate override as 'argued about', which is a modelling definition no reader is told, and ADR 0028 (a sensitivity grid is eighty-one valuations) is the neighbouring record the new ADR should cite.
newAdrs: ADR A — A reconciliation pass owns the assembled document, and an approved report contains no undecided challenge. Extends services/consistency.py's rule from facts to calculations and to negative assertions; extends ADR 0095's briefing scope to require settlement before publication (it still briefs rather than decides, it just refuses to ship undecided). Must say why a check over the frozen draft differs from ADR 0087's authored half and sits beside ADR 0098's 'a refused revision leaves the approved draft standing'.

ADR B — The view a report carries is the operator's, stated at approval as a thesis with a holder, a time, a basis that cannot be blank and its falsifiers; displayed and never cited. Names ADR 0074 (a judgement is never a source reference), ADR 0102 (the judgements supertype), ADR 0087 (the authored verdict is a different thing) and the RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS rule at core/schemas/skill.py:73-91, and says explicitly that no model and no calculation may write reports.rating. Settles reports.confidence in the same record: retired from every render branch, or the operator's own on the judgement row, never a model's.

ADR C — Amendment to ADR 0030 route 2: which price-derived figures may be displayed in a shareable artefact. Covers the market capitalisation, the enterprise value, the multiples and the implied up/downside, and states whether a quoted close may be printed. Also settles F-28: what a per-share valuation is per when the request names a depositary listing, and that the basis is stated on the row.

ADR D — Amendment to ADR 0034: the assembler accepts a CompsTable when the provider's policy permits a derived figure, and the shareable comps type carries the confirmed peer names and their rationales. ADR 0034's mechanism is kept — the type still decides — and the decision moves from a hard-coded signature to the licence flag ADR 0030's 2026-08-09 amendment already set. One amendment covering both the type's contents and the assembler's signature, not two passes.

ADR E — Amendment to ADR 0058: a section that wants dimensioned facts asks for them explicitly by axis, and every dimensioned figure is rendered with its axis and its member. Mandatory rather than optional: ADR 0058's Decision names 'section evidence packs' among the four readers that must filter dimension_axis IS NULL, and carving an exception to one of the four without recording it is a silent breach. Must also state what covered_figures does, since it will accept a dimensioned fact id as cover for any numeral without knowing it is a slice.

ADR F — An accession is a set of documents, not one: acquisition fetches a current report's typed EX-99 exhibits alongside its primary document, bounded and capped, each dated by the index's filed date and tiered as the regulatory record. Must state what happens to figures read from an exhibit's tables — nothing numeric, because covered_figures requires a fact or calculation id and there is no table-to-rows extractor — or the next session will try to let a writer quote one.

ADR G — Code adjudicates a challenge's arithmetic premise; it never adjudicates its argument. Extends ADR 0039's evidence check from 'the id exists' to 'the comparison the id supports is between like periods', and amends ADR 0039's 'materiality follows severity' to 'materiality follows severity and a surviving premise'. A challenge code has shown to be comparing unlike periods raises no banner and buys no redraft, and is still recorded and still published.

ADR H — The brief is carried to the writers and the answer is measured: the operator's focus questions compose verbatim into every writing and research role, in the trusted half of the turn, and a deterministic answers block refuses an entry with no cited figure. Sits under ADR 0108's rule that a methodology skill composes into the roles that plan and write and into no role that judges — request fields the operator typed are not skill text, so nothing relaxes.

ADR I — A synthesis section is dealt the run's own drafted claims as evidence, and may restate a figure only by naming the claim id that already carries its lineage. Amends what ADR 0055 admits to a section as evidence; must say why a drafted claim handed back to a writer is not the model laundering its own prose into the evidence chain, with the claim-id guard as the decision rather than an implementation note. ADR 0087's 'never evidence' rule for authored interpretation is the nearest precedent pointing the other way.

ADR J — A scenario is an operator-confirmed assumption override, and what it holds fixed: whether a scenario overriding beta or the risk-free rate recomputes the WACC, and that the answer is stated on the rendered scenario row. Sits inside ADR 0046's propose-and-confirm shape; cites ADR 0028.

ADR K — A bank's revenue. TWO possible records and they say different kinds of thing, so the operator's choice picks which is written. For withholding: 'An ASC 606 component is not a total where the filer reports a larger revenue line outside ASC 606's scope for the same period' — a statement about the taxonomy, which is why it can live at the parse layer and needs no classification. For deriving: 'A bank's revenue is net interest income plus non-interest income' — a modelling definition joining ADR 0070 and ADR 0029, which must also state that a reported total always wins and that a single present component never derives.

ADR L — A decision may be superseded exactly when the payload it was taken on no longer exists, and the superseding decision is recorded as AMENDED beside the original rather than replacing it. Amends ADR 0090's approvals vocabulary. Must say what a superseding decision does to the frozen seal, since the FINAL gate's expected hash comes from the seal step and not from the live page.

ADR M — A gap is a declared field, not a forbidden sentence. Supersedes ADR 0100's mechanism while keeping its finding (a repeated remark costs the remark, not the section), and states why the budget becomes a measurement rather than a refusal. Must show that the composer at aer.core.skill_policy keeps the new writable field additive-only, so invariant 7 is untouched.

ADR N — Amendment to ADR 0109: a numeric claim naming a fact is checked against that fact's value, and a figure's scale word is part of the figure. ADR 0109 removed the citation requirement from numeric claims and made the id the evidence, which is exactly what makes the missing value check load-bearing; the scale-word half sits inside ADR 0060 and amends ADR 0097's stated escape hatch, which is wrong as written because cited_figure_agreement shares the same blind ladder.

CONDITIONAL, named so they are not forgotten: an ADR for raising a named section's tier ceiling to T5 (operator decision 6, deferred past step 12; must say which of ADR 0092 and ADR 0111 it amends); an ADR 0059 third amendment if peer acquisition is taken (operator decision 5); and an ADR 0016 amendment if cost rows are ever published inside a step — NOT in this plan, and the record should note that ADR 0016's 'nothing here does' is already false, since the draft fan-out commits inside its own step.
notDoing: THE UK ACQUISITION PATH, entirely — all of uk/uk-adapter-unwired, uk-ch-document-format-probe, uk-identifier-lands-in-the-cik-column, uk-facts-need-an-ixbrl-path, uk-citations-need-a-presentation-locator, uk-sic-scheme-mismatch, uk-pit-anchor-differs, uk-peers-and-fulltext-are-edgar-only, gbp-risk-free-is-not-the-blocker. It is seven to ten sessions, one or two ADRs and at least one live run, it is net-new scope with no phase in remaining-work.md, and it delivers an annual-only, months-late, peerless evidence base for a company class whose US-listed compatriots already work. WHAT I AM DOING INSTEAD, for an hour and a half: stop selling the dead end (refuse an LSE request at creation, fix the refusal that tells an operator AstraZeneca is 'a different company', correct the knowledge map). The product documents will then claim only what the product does, which is the honest interim.

PHASE 6 — authentication, inbound rate limiting, a deployment story (roadmap A5/A7/A8). Gated on intent to leave one machine, and neither issue creates that intent: the product is one operator, one laptop, one report at a time. 'User ready' sounds like it implies authentication; it does not.

EVERYTHING ON THE DECIDED-AGAINST LIST — trade execution, a portfolio optimiser, multi-user, investment advice, a positions table, a Bank of England adapter, FCA NSM fetching, an external tracing vendor. In particular the stated view must not become investment advice, which is the one place this plan presses against that list and is why ADR B exists rather than a template change.

THE SPEED PROGRAMME beyond two free items. No judge finding cites latency; the console won on content. I am taking the concurrent revise (10-11 minutes of every run, provably serial, and this plan pays for six runs) and linking the two first-read surfaces that already exist and are linked from nowhere. I am NOT taking the plan-spine reordering (it turns on whether the engine can hold two AWAITING_APPROVAL gates in one wave, which nobody has established, and collapses to ten seconds if it cannot), the composed gate sitting, the extract profiling, quick mode, or notifications. Use case 7 stays 'no'.

PEER ACQUISITION, in this programme. The subject's own P/E and EV/EBITDA already exist, already trace and already replay, and are thrown away at a render boundary — that is a session and it closes two checklist rows. Acquiring eight peers is a few sessions, an ADR 0059 amendment, and the exact condition ADR 0061 was written to stop. Deferred to operator decision 5, after the verdict round, with the £21-30 seeding experiment as the cheap way to settle it with real data.

RAISING THE EVIDENCE TIER CEILING so news reaches a section. Deferred to operator decision 6. Step 9 does the half that has to happen first anyway (worker-fetched pages become excerptable, and an EDGAR exhibit enters at T1 rather than T5), which is most of the value without the ADR.

THE METERING AND INTEGRITY ITEMS — publishing cost rows inside a step (sibling spend, lost rows), the audit-chain trigger, the DATA_API category, the model-route validator, the shuffled CI job, the documented-count drift. No user meets any of them today, two need ADRs, and the shared fix is larger than the diagnosis states because Cost.agent_run_id foreign-keys an uncommitted agent_runs row. THE EXCEPTION, taken at step 8: the two figure guards (scale word, fact-backed claim value), because they defend the platform's only unqualified win and the programme is about to publish more figures than it ever has.

A CHAIN-AND-ARTEFACT VERIFICATION PAGE. It is the platform's strongest use case living only in a terminal and it deserves building — but verify_store re-hashes every artefact (559 in the audit pass), which is a background job with a progress surface rather than a request handler, and it moves no judge and removes no dead end. Named here so it is not lost.

MODEL-WRITTEN RATINGS, TARGETS OR CONFIDENCE. A one-word label with no holder, no time and no stated basis is the closest thing this tool can produce to regulated advice. Refused through the built-in door as firmly as RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS refuses it through the skill door.

A MODEL JUDGE AT RUN TIME. Proposed as an alternative to the three deterministic metrics and refused: a model scoring a model's prose cannot be replayed, costs money on every run, and would make the measurement of this plan circular. The judge panel stays an occasional acceptance harness under audit/.

risks.risk: THE STEER COMES BACK UNCHANGED — the AZN run at step 7 still draws 'no' 3 of 3 and 3 of 3 comparisons still choose the console. This has already happened once: azn2 fixed the valuation, moved view_stated to 3/3, and changed no verdict.
risks.mitigation: That is exactly why the steer is at step 7 for £10.50 rather than at step 12 for £29, and why it is on the one subject where the thesis has already half-failed. Pre-register the reading: if the decisive fields have moved off contradiction, price and the missing view and on to missing figures, the plan's ordering is right and W5/W6 are the next spend. If they have NOT moved — if judges still name the header or the accusations — the spine work did not land and the bug is in the implementation, not the plan. If they name neither, the thesis is wrong and W5 and W7 move ahead of W6 before another session is spent.

risks.risk: THE NEW CROSS-SECTION CHECK REFUSES EVERY RUN. A deterministic figure index over a 14,000-word document with 831 calculations will find genuine near-misses (a rounded figure in prose against a stored value, a fact quoted at two scales) and could make gate 2 unreachable.
risks.mitigation: Ship it as a gate-2 report, not a refusal, and promote it only after two consecutive clean live runs (operator decision 7). Scope the negative-assertion scan to a declared absence vocabulary matched against concepts the document actually publishes as figures — structural, not lexical — rather than to open negation detection. And the programme's own escape hatch is step 2's re-measure and supersede actions, built before this lands precisely so a new blocking check cannot strand a run.

risks.risk: THE SEGMENT AND COMPS WORK REOPENS ADR 0061's CROSS-ISSUER CONTAMINATION — the failure that once put Walmart, Alibaba, eBay, JD.com, MercadoLibre and Target in an Amazon note's evidence.
risks.mitigation: The standing scope test lands at step 2, before any evidence-widening item: for any run, every fact id in every built-in section's pack resolves to the subject's company_id and to a tier at or below the section's ceiling. It is the test that fails first. Note it is wider than the diagnosis says — the tier index also contains quarantined documents, so a content field can today name a document the run quarantined for being published after the as-of date, and the test must cover that too.

risks.risk: PUBLISHING MORE FIGURES RAISES THE ACCURACY EXPOSURE. The programme adds market capitalisations, enterprise values, implied returns, multiples, segment lines and scenario outputs to a document whose '0 contradicted of 779' is the platform's only unqualified win — and the reading ladder discards the scale word, so '$331.8 million' over a stored 331,839,000,000 passes both the draft rule and the metric.
risks.mitigation: The two missing guards land in step 8, in the SAME phase as the new figures rather than after them. Budget the scale-word fix at a few sessions rather than one: the blocker is not reads_as's signature but that numerals_in returns a frozenset and the rule does set arithmetic on it, so the whole path has to become position-carrying, in core/, under mypy --strict. Acceptance is that all five audit runs' archived drafts replay with zero NEW refusals.

risks.risk: THE JUDGES ARE THREE MODEL READINGS THAT MAY BE FORMAT-CONFOUNDED. Across 9 comparisons and 6 dimensions the vote was 51 console, 3 equal, 0 platform, and the three lenses agreed on would_act_on_it 9 times out of 9 — either a very strong signal or three prompts to one model sharing a prior. The September blind was also nominal: the console side sat in a directory literally named 'baseline'.
risks.mitigation: Neutral identically-shaped paths before any judge sees a path; the identity-guess rubric key with the hit rate reported beside the verdict; a round where judges guess correctly 8 or 9 of 9 reported as format-confounded rather than clean, with the focus-question-only instrument as the tie-break. Include one discriminating pair (the platform's MSFT document against the platform's own AZN document) and check the lenses disagree somewhere. And say in the protocol that September's judge configuration is unrecorded, so the two rounds are compared with that caveat rather than despite it.

risks.risk: THE PROGRAMME STALLS ON AN UNANSWERED OPERATOR DECISION. Eight decisions gate seven of twelve steps.
risks.mitigation: Every decision above carries a recommendation and a stated default, and the running order names which step each gates. Three are needed before step 5 (budget, ADR 0030, whose view); one before step 8's optional branch; three are explicitly deferred past step 12. If ADR 0030 is answered 'keep withholding', step 5 shrinks and the plan states out loud that ISSUE 2 acquires a ceiling it cannot clear, rather than proceeding quietly.

risks.risk: EFFORT OVERRUN. Roughly 43 sessions across nine workstreams and fourteen ADRs, by one person driving AI sessions. Several diagnosis estimates were already weakened by their own refuters for good reasons — the scale-word fix, the exhibit-as-table change, the re-measurement after revise (which needs a deterministic-only entry point carved out of evaluate_run first), and the declared gap field.
risks.mitigation: The order is designed to be stoppable at three points that each leave a better product than today: after step 6 the document has a spine (record visible, no contradiction, anchored, a view); after step 9 the evidence is legible in the exported file, which is the measured axis the platform should already have won; after step 11 the prose argues. The steer at step 7 is the decision point on whether to continue. Nothing in steps 8-11 is a prerequisite of anything in steps 1-6.

risks.risk: THE LIVE-RUN BUDGET IS NOT ACTUALLY AVAILABLE. £43 core against £36.68 of audit residue, and that residue is read live from the costs table rather than being a durable fact.
risks.mitigation: Named as operator decision 1, before any money moves, with an absolute new ceiling asserted by the ledger at the protocol's own commit. The floor if the budget is refused is £10.50 — the steer alone — after which the plan continues offline and the verdict is deferred rather than the work being done unmeasured.

plans.totalEffort: About 43 AI coding sessions across twelve steps — roughly 40 for the workstreams plus 3 of journey fixes landed between live runs — with fourteen ADRs to draft, four of which (A, B, C, K) must exist before their code. At four sessions a week that is ten to twelve weeks; at two, five to six months. Three stopping points are built in: step 6 (~19 sessions, the document has a spine), step 9 (~32, the evidence is legible in the exported file), step 11 (~43, the prose argues). The steer at step 7 is the decision point on whether steps 8-12 are worth their sessions at all.
firstThreeThings: Port F-27's evidence fix into `gather_evidence` (sections/evidence.py:580-588 → the query already written at services/red_team.py:343-374): order by name then newest period, one row per (name, case), skip sensitivity cells, carry the period, bound calculations separately from facts. One session, no ADR, no decision, no spend. Until it lands, the Executive Summary and Investment Thesis are arguing from a pack that structurally excludes the valuation — which is why msft1's says 'no valuation output, no discount rate and no peer multiple' eleven lines under a front page printing WACC 9.3% and $485.29 — and every other item in this plan, and every judgement of it, is measuring the wrong thing.

Make the document incapable of contradicting itself and incapable of shipping an undecided accusation: extend services/consistency.py from facts to calculation rows and to negative assertions over the assembled draft (reporting at gate 2, not refusing, until two clean runs), render the operator's settlement in place of 'Escalated for human decision at approval.', and refuse FINAL while any disagreement is escalated. Three sessions and ADR A. It removes the reason 7 of 9 and 8 of 9 decisive fields gave, and it is what makes 'the header may never contradict the thesis' an enforceable rule rather than a hope.

Give the run a price and a place to put a view: fix the bars count that loses the whole price layer on any warm database (price_acquisition.py:477), prefer market equity in the WACC so the report stops telling its reader that its own valuation is too high, put market capitalisation and the implied up/downside on the page as traced calculations, and let the operator state their own non-binding view at the final gate with a basis and its falsifiers. Six sessions, ADRs B and C, and two operator decisions. It removes the reason the remaining 8 of 9 decisive fields gave — and it is the pair, not either half, that does it: azn2 already proved a view with nothing to anchor it changes no verdict.

plans.thesis: Fixing these two issues means one thing before it means anything else: the operator must be able to get a run to the end, and get it there again after something goes wrong, without a terminal and without paying £7 to find out. Everything else is downstream of that, for a reason the audit's own ledger proves rather than asserts. Three of six runs reached an approved rendered report; two of the three that did not — MSFT #2 and MTB, £6.80 and £7.61 — can be re-measured nowhere, because the eleven evaluation rows are written once inside `validate`, the engine skips any step whose row says SUCCEEDED (workflow/engine.py:518-527), and a rejected gate leaves the job AWAITING_APPROVAL, which is not terminal, so `runs._may_be_superseded` (services/runs.py:165-172) will not even let the operator start again. That is £14.41 of a £100 budget destroyed by the absence of a button. Now consider what the second half of this plan is: roughly forty changes to a document whose only honest acceptance criterion is "re-run the brief and re-judge it blind". At the audit's observed loss rate a three-run re-measurement round is one strand away from being half a round, and every document fix proved live costs more than the fix itself. So the organising idea is not that dead ends are unpleasant. It is that **the recovery paths are the measuring instrument for the document work**: the cheapest way to buy forty document fixes is to make them provable offline — re-rendering a stored run, `aer replay-draft`, `aer rehearse-section` — and to spend a live run only on what no stored run can exercise. Build the loop first and you get a walkable journey, a subject class (banks) that can produce a report at all, and a free proof harness. Build the document first and you get a better-looking artefact you still cannot produce twice, cannot re-score after a late fix, and cannot compare against itself — and you find that out at £7 a lesson, which is exactly how the audit spent a third of its budget.

workstreams.name: A — Stop losing runs
workstreams.whyItMatters: Two of six audit runs were destroyed by the absence of a re-measure action and a superseding decision; a third subject class (banks) cannot produce an approvable report at all. Until a run can be finished and recovered, every later fix is proved at £7 a time and half the proofs are lost. This workstream is also what turns the audit's five stored runs into a free test bench for workstreams C–G.
items: bank/bank-revenue-definition — take withhold-first-then-derive: demote an ASC 606 component at the parse layer (sources/sec/companyfacts.py:199-235) when the filer reports a larger out-of-scope revenue line for the same period, then add the traced bank sum on top. ADR 0113.

bank/revenue-fix-must-reach-six-surfaces — the parse-layer demotion is what reaches `_figure_scenes`, `_latest_rows`, `_annual_series`, `_revenue_margin_input` and the drafter's pack; the derivation alone clears 4 of 11 findings and leaves gate 2 refusing.

bank/turnover-check-never-fires — `_figure_scenes` queries the concept `total_assets`; the canonical concept is `assets` (evaluations.py:612,646). Change the two strings, add the service-level test, and add the assertion that every concept `_figure_scenes` names is a key of the canonical set. Ship with or immediately after the revenue fix (it adds two findings before it removes any).

journey/refused-check-no-remeasure — a "Score this run again" action that invalidates the `validate` step row, records who asked, re-enqueues; plus making a REJECTED gate superseding-eligible. ADR 0116, which must also settle whether the earlier evaluation rows survive, because services/evaluations.py:862 currently DELETEs them by design.

journey/stale-approval-dead-end — close the open door (refuse an amend or create against a request whose ASSUMPTIONS gate is decided, reusing gates.refuse_settling_after_decision's shape) and open the exit (a superseding Decision.AMENDED admitted exactly when the recorded approval matches neither the seal nor the live page). ADR 0114.

journey/terminal-still-required — the re-seal action on the gate page, so the pause message stops naming `aer reseal`; plus a preflight panel on the run-start page. The integrity page and the run export download move to workstream B.

journey/decided-gate-still-says-waiting — `pending_gate` returns None when the named gate carries a decision; the console gains a third state naming the decision that stopped the run. Six callers, not one (web/gates.py:219, overview/research.py:57, overview/research_pages.py:68, api/routes/runs.py:378) — the API contract moves with it.

journey/enqueue-failure-is-silent — carry `enqueue_run`'s failure into the redirect; stop the console's queued line falling through to the reassuring default when Redis is unreachable; give an AWAITING_APPROVAL job whose gate is decided a re-queue action.

uk/uk-request-dead-end — refuse an LSE research request at creation with a research-scope rule in services/requests.py, keeping SUPPORTED_EXCHANGES intact for the book; `audit/smoke.py:120-148` moves to asserting a clean refusal rather than FAILED.

uk/uk-refusal-misreads-the-adr-route — pass the requested company name into resolution so "AstraZeneca PLC, AZN, LSE" is told to re-commission on NYSE rather than told it is a different company. Note this changes the SourceAdapter protocol, so both adapters move.

measure/dead-end-inventory-is-the-issue-1-test — the inventory, committed before any code, with the September cost of each unfixed row beside it. NEW: cost-annotate every row, and derive the list from runs/console.html's own panels as well as from §5, because the failed-step fallback at console.html:148-157 is a page pointing the reader at a terminal and the `remedy` branch deliberately offers no control.

NEW: replay-first rule — a document change ships only with an offline proof (re-render from a stored run, `aer replay-draft`, or `aer rehearse-section`); a live run is spent only on what no stored run can exercise. Written into CONTRIBUTING.md and into the protocol, and it is what makes workstreams C–G affordable.

NEW: restore or re-create the replay subjects — eleven acceptance criteria across the diagnosis assume `aer replay-draft <job-id>` against the audit's five jobs, and nothing establishes that database or artefact store survives. Settle it in step 1; if it is gone, the plan buys one seeding run and says so.
workstreams.exitCriterion: Every row of the committed dead-end inventory has a browser-proved forward control, asserted by the journey harness; the harness reports zero states with no forward control and zero pages whose visible text names a shell command; and one live bank run reaches an approved, rendered report with `figure_plausibility` 0 of 0, no terminal use and no rescue.

workstreams.name: B — The loop is walkable without a terminal
workstreams.whyItMatters: Six or seven stops, 26,392–34,540 words of gate pages, two to five values hand-typed with justifications on every single run, 135 code identifiers on the pages a person decides on, and a 500 that renders as JSON. None of this stops a run, and all of it makes the loop expensive enough that the operator walks it less often — which directly reduces how much the document work can be measured.
items: journey/assumptions-hand-typed-every-run — wire the built-but-uncalled macro client into `ServiceBundle` and `for_execution` and acquire the currency's risk-free series before `propose_assumptions`, so the discount rate's largest input becomes a dated, sourced observation instead of an operator's typed number. Read ADR 0082/0084 first: the acquisition half may already be a decided decision. ADR 0117 covers only the standing-value half (the equity risk premium held in settings and re-proposed into every run, confirmed at the gate like any other).

journey/unmapped-gate-unanswerable — lead with the rows above a stated materiality band, collapse the rest behind one disclosure with both counts stated, and keep the approved payload hashing all rows. Must also handle `payload.refused_concepts`, which the page renders below the unmapped table. ADR only if the gate stops firing when every tag is below the band.

journey/developer-vocabulary-everywhere — move METRIC_WORDS and the tier words out of aer.web.vocabulary into a neutral module both the renderer and the interface import; render scores through the house-style door; extend presentation_integrity to fail on a bare metric identifier and an unformatted Decimal in reader prose. The English names already exist and are already test-walked; the work is making the render path reach them.

journey/server-error-is-json — negotiate on Accept so an HTML request gets the problem page with a link back to the run; change the generic sentence to name the worker log and the run console rather than an absent support desk; one browser test per gate against a multi-period fixture.

ADR 0115, an amendment to ADR 0029. journey/sector-gate-third-answer is the same item.

speed/first-read-surfaces-exist-and-are-unreachable — link /runs/{id}/preview and /runs/{id}/summary from the console while a run is RUNNING, read-only, never /review; fix the PENDING status line, which says "This section was not generated." speed/the-runtime-estimate-at-gate-one-counts-the-research-wave-five-times — merge the step intervals instead of summing them and render the estimate in words; correct audit/scoring/platform_report.py and re-state §4.2's 31–42 minutes as the true 26.5–36.8.

journey/terminal-still-required (second half) — the "Check this platform's record" page running verify_audit_chain, and the run export as a download. Budget the artefact walk separately: re-hashing 559 artefacts is a background job with a progress surface, not a request handler.
uk/uk-claims-in-developer-docs — correct knowledge-map.md:82,171 and vertical_slice_v1.py:2322-2323, both of which tell a reader (human or AI session) that a UK acquisition path exists.
workstreams.exitCriterion: On the journey harness: zero UUIDs and zero unledgered snake_case tokens in visible page text across every page the journey visits; zero pages naming a shell command; the bank's gate-page word total under 20,000 with every tag still reachable; values the operator must supply at the assumptions gate down from 2/5/3 to at most one; and a readable figure surface exists on the console before the ten-minute mark.

workstreams.name: C — The document stops disagreeing with itself
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the journey defect the reader meets. Every judge who read a platform report found it saying two incompatible things about a load-bearing figure and shipping severity-5 accusations against its own margins marked "Escalated for human decision at approval" and never decided. A document that tells its reader not to trust its headline numbers is a dead end in prose, and no amount of new evidence in workstreams F and G survives it. The root cause is one query and one render string, both cheap.
items: view/writers-never-see-the-valuation — the keystone. gather_evidence orders calculations `period_end DESC NULLS LAST` and takes 40 rows with no pool and no ranking (sections/evidence.py:97,580-588), while calc/engine.py:165-169 gives every discount rate and per-share output `period = None`. Port the fix already written, reviewed and tested in services/red_team.py:343-374: one row per (name, case) at its newest period, sensitivity cells excluded, period on every entry, calculations bounded separately from facts. No ADR — it changes what a writer sees, not what it may say.

prose/sections-are-blind-to-the-record — the same defect, plus the front-page floor: the figures the glance block prints must be in every section's pack before the ranked remainder. For the two 2,000-token one_pager sections the budget binds first, so the floor needs a reserved allocation, which is a budget change whether or not it is called one.

judges/contradiction-and-self-accusation — re-scoped per the refuter: extend services/consistency.py (which already groups published FinancialFacts by concept+period+dimension and runs at `validate`) to Calculation rows and to a negative-assertion scan over the assembled draft. The refusal goes through the gate's evidence rule or a new blocking check, never through eval/metrics.py — `_validate`'s own docstring is "scores, never a pause" and msft2 reached AWAITING_APPROVAL with presentation_integrity failing.

redteam/period-blind-figure-comparison — a deterministic adjudication on the disagreement row where a challenge's cited calculation and the claim's cited calculation share a name and differ in period. Replay `_evidence_index` over AZN #2's stored calculations under post-F-27 code first: that is a free read and it decides whether this is a session well spent or a closed hole.

redteam/one-footnote-per-challenge — footnote every cited id and print the period beside each figure, so no reader repeats the footnote forensics all three judges performed.
redteam/appendix-calls-them-source-disagreements — split the section: "Adversarial review" and "Source conflicts", sharing one helper with the review page so the two cannot drift.

redteam/challenge-figures-are-unchecked-prose — structured `figure_claims` (calculation_id plus the value read off it), refusing the challenge whole when the value disagrees with the row, rendering figure and period from the row. Drop the "every numeral must appear" rule as unenforceable.

redteam/metrics-describe-a-different-document — re-measure the per-section run-time metrics inside `revise` before the payload hash is sealed, which removes the late-stop risk. First carve a deterministic-only entry point out of evaluate_run, whose AgentContext and `use_batch` parameter say it is not model-free today.

Note the second route the diagnosis missed: AZN #2 left four challenged sections unrevised under MAX_REVISED_SECTIONS=4, so the body already mixes answered and unanswered sections for one challenge.

The new blocking check fails against HEAD on all four constructed fixtures.
workstreams.effort: 10 sessions plus one ADR (0122, covering the adjudicator, materiality and the settlement requirement — amends ADR 0039 and extends ADR 0095)

workstreams.name: D — The document states the figures a note is read for
workstreams.whyItMatters: Eight of nine blind comparisons named the missing price in the decisive field; six of six judges said the figures a research note is read for are withheld. Every one of these figures already exists as a traced, replayed calculation in the run that refused to print it. This is the highest ratio of judge-visible gain to new machinery in the whole plan, and almost none of it needs new arithmetic.

Prefer testing `adjusted_series_for(...).bars`, which is what downstream actually consumes. Fix the identical peer-path bug at price_acquisition.py:337 in the same commit — it is a prerequisite for any peer work.

comps/wacc-uses-book-equity-even-with-a-market-cap-in-hand — thread the price step's market capitalisation into `_cost_of_capital`; use EquityBasis.MARKET when present. judges/no-price-no-position — market capitalisation, enterprise value and the implied upside or downside against each per-share output as traced calculations on the glance block and in the valuation section; every per-share row names its share basis (F-28). Drop the dependency on peers: the subject's capitalisation is computed at price_acquisition.py:234 independently of any peer.

comps/report-cannot-carry-a-multiple — `assemble_document(comps: CompsTable | WithheldComps | None)` with the caller passing `for_audience(SHAREABLE)`; ADR 0034's mechanism kept, the decision moved from a hard-coded signature to the licence flag ADR 0030's 2026-08-09 amendment already set. Must touch render/html.py:125-127 and render/summary.py:49, not Markdown alone, and must footnote each multiple to its recorded calculation (comps_run.py:170-173 says the outcome carries no ids, so persist them or read the ledger at render).

comps/multiples-are-unnamed-undated-rows — re-aimed: surface the parameters and input labels the ledger already holds onto the EvidenceUnit and the run export, and add the missing `context.period(...)` scope so a multiple stops sorting last. Do not rename six recorded calculations for an evidence-labelling problem; that moves a replay boundary.

comps/peers-are-never-named-in-the-report — carry the confirmed peer names and rationales onto WithheldComps and print them. Interim only if the comps table stays empty; fold into the same ADR 0119 amendment rather than a second pass at ADR 0034.

comps/surfaces-still-quote-the-withdrawn-licence-position — drive the peer-gate callout and the withholding paragraph off `derived_figures_publishable`, binding at the call site (`comps_note_for`) that chooses between table and notice.

segments-guidance/segment-rows-invisible-to-every-section-writer — a `search_segment_facts` evidence category selected explicitly by axis, enabled only on the sections that declare it, every unit carrying `dimension_axis` and `dimension_member`. segments-guidance/segment-exhibit-vanishes-on-every-second-run — scope `_segment_input` and `_revenue_margin_input` by company and the run's point-in-time window rather than by job_id. view/report-promises-a-view-it-never-records — replace the two hardcoded "Recorded at this run's approval." strings with the run's composed figures, and bound `_trim` to significant figures: today the composed range renders as "169.798802002887 to 333.476013557285 USD/shares" on a shareable surface.

bank/bank-front-page-has-no-bank-figures — sector-keyed headline tuples, threading the already-resolved profile down from assemble_document's caller rather than importing services into render. The recorded name is `residual_income_per_share`; the mapping must say so.

bank/bank-required-metrics-none-computed — tangible book value per share (every input is mapped and M&T holds all of them) and loan-loss provisions; verify the string `compute_ratios` persists as Calculation.name before writing the disclosure test.
bank/residual-income-illegible-without-a-price (split half 1) — book value per share on the same table as the appraised value, and the football field and heatmap bands rendered as text in Markdown.
