workstreams.effort: 13 sessions plus three ADRs (0119 the price-derived amendment and the share basis, 0120 the WACC weight, 0121 the ADR 0058 amendment)

workstreams.name: E — The exported document carries the platform's advantage
workstreams.whyItMatters: 259 of 259 citations verified, 3,335 calculation rows replayed, every artefact hashed — and the platform won verifiability in none of the nine comparisons, and was slower to check (10–30 minutes against the console's 10–15). The excerpt code re-read to confirm each citation is stored and never printed; the inputs a calculation records are stored and never printed; three exhibits export as a caption and a run of bare markers. This is the one dimension where the platform is already better in kind and loses in practice, and the fix is to stop discarding evidence at the last step.
items: judges/verifiability-lost-in-the-export — extend SourceFootnote with the verified excerpt and the locator (concept, period and unit for an XBRL fact; item and quoted sentence for a filing), and CalculationFootnote with its inputs by name, value, unit and their own markers. sections/render.py:86 already carries financial_fact_id and extraction_id as hidden provenance keys, so the writer needs no new plumbing. Fix `_cite`'s de-duplication to key on identifier alone, which is why four identical notes survive today.

journey/exported-footnote-has-no-excerpt — the same item from the journey side; take them as one change across Markdown, HTML and PDF. Settle the licence rule in the same commit: `aer purge-licensed` exists because a terminated subscription obliges deletion of every stored payload, and a verbatim excerpt copied into an immutable exported artefact is a payload copy the purge cannot reach. Print excerpts only for tiers whose licence permits redistribution.

segments-guidance/the-exhibit-is-the-only-carrier-and-it-carries-no-numbers — label every bar with its stored value and give the Markdown notation a data table beneath the deferral line for tabular exhibits. This needs a `rows` field on Chart and ChartView and re-pinned byte-stability tests; the "Markdown only" option is not cheaper. Amends ADR 0043's consequences 4 and 5 — consequence 5's claim that the figures already resolve is the sentence the judges disproved.

prose/no-front-door-on-the-exported-document — emit the one-pager as the exported document's front matter (the narrowed view is already built and is linked from no template at all), and de-duplicate footnotes on the source document id or calculation id, never on note text. msft1 carries 142 footnotes with 70 distinct texts; azn2 148 with 70.
view/one-pager-omits-the-investment-thesis — a one-row migration adding investment_thesis to the one_pager set, so the one page a reader opens carries the section that argues the view.
roadmap/the-shared-document-has-no-roadmap-item — this workstream is that item; it must enter §2 with a number, because the exported file has never had a roadmap entry.

evidence-policy/reader-is-not-told-a-claims-tier — print the evidence tier with the recorded tier beside it when they differ (the rule ADR 0111 already wrote for the evidence table), and a per-section marker on any section citing an evidence-tier-5 source, assembled as the C3 undated marker is. This is a precondition of workstream F's ceiling decision, not a follow-up to it.
workstreams.exitCriterion: Re-rendering MSFT #1 and AZN #2 offline and re-judging the exports: `minutes_to_check_three_figures` falls to 10 or below in at least 2 of 3 reads and below the console's figure on the same subject; `better_on_verifiability` returns the platform in at least 2 of 3 comparisons; no judge's verifiability note says a figure "cannot be located" or "cannot be reproduced from anything in the document"; and every exhibit's stored values appear in the Markdown.
workstreams.effort: 7 sessions, no new ADR beyond an amendment note on ADR 0043 and a licence rule recorded beside ADR 0030/0031

workstreams.name: F — The document answers the brief it was commissioned on
workstreams.whyItMatters: Across 27 focus-question readings the platform scored 1 yes, 17 partly, 9 no, against the console's 6 yes, 21 partly, 0 no. The operator's own words reach the planner and the plan critic and nothing else — not the five research workers who hold the tools and spend the search budget, not a single section writer, no validator. Meanwhile the run fetches material it then cannot publish: an exhibit under an accession it already holds enters at T5 and is dropped by every section's T4 ceiling, and a worker-fetched page gets no Extraction rows so nothing can ever cite it. This is where the console's whole advantage on recency and question-answering lives.
items: evidence-policy/workers-never-see-the-focus-questions — a bounded focus_questions list on WorkerInput, rendered in the trusted half of the worker's turn beside the topic brief. The cheapest item in the plan and it multiplies every other item in this workstream, because an unaimed search budget wastes the reach the rest creates. Needs the prompt_version bump and the _LIMITS declaration a new bounded field requires.

judges/brief-never-travels-past-the-planner — compose the operator's focus questions verbatim into every section writer's user turn under the same delimiter as standing guidance (they are request fields the operator typed, not skill text); add an "Answers to your questions" block that refuses to emit an entry with no cited figure; add a `brief_coverage` measurement shown at gate 2, with the refusal living in the block's emitter rather than in a metric, since metrics cannot pause a run.

segments-guidance/the-8k-exhibit-is-never-fetched / evidence-policy/acquire-fetches-only-primary-documents — read the accession's file index and acquire typed EX-99 exhibits at T1 with the index's filed date, bounded and capped. `discover_documents` builds refs from primary documents only and cannot enumerate an accession, so this needs a new client method, an index.json parser and a replay fixture. ADR 0123, which must also state what happens to figures read from an exhibit's tables — there is no table-to-rows extractor anywhere in src/aer/extract/, and `covered_figures` requires every sound numeric claim to carry a fact or calculation id, so the exhibit buys guidance sentences and recent-developments prose, never the console's segment dollar table.

segments-guidance/current-reports-chosen-by-date-not-by-what-happened — keep `items` on `Filing` (EDGAR publishes it and submissions.py discards it), reserve slots for Item 2.02 and 7.01, and for a 6-K prefer the results announcement by keyword over total-voting-rights and admission notices. AZN's half-year results 6-K — where an FPI states its guidance — never made the five-deep window.

judges/record-stops-at-the-last-annual-filing — the same selection fix plus admitting a foreign private issuer's results 6-K to the periodic set and extracting its EX-99 statements. AZN's report, dated 12 September 2026, is built on a record that stops at 31 December 2025 and says so.

evidence-policy/exhibit-enters-at-t5-then-excluded — a fetched EDGAR archive URL whose accession appears in the run's own acquired filings enters at T1 with the index's filed date. Normalise CIK padding and the accession's dashes before matching, or it misses exactly the case that motivated it: the worker fetched a zero-padded CIK path and fulltext.py never emits one.

evidence-policy/fetched-pages-are-never-excerpted — move filings._excerpt to a shared service and call it from `_fetch_known_url` after record_acquisition. Worthless without the tier fix and vice versa; take them together. `_text_of` discards the ExtractedText record_excerpts needs and memoises a (str, note) pair, so the cache changes shape too.

evidence-policy/builtin-tier-ceiling-t4 — the operator's decision. Recommended: publish a new version of the definition rows raising max_tier to 5 for industry_landscape, growth_outlook, key_risks, catalysts and recent_developments, keeping min_sources and requires_primary unchanged, with claim-level tier marking (workstream E) already shipped. Publish a version row, never an in-place merge, because draft_replay reads the pinned policy. ADR 0124, which must be argued against ADR 0111's recorded/evidence tier split and against ADR 0092's claim that granting web_search moved no trust boundary.

evidence-policy/no-section-houses-recent-developments — a `recent_developments` definition row after management_governance, with a hard word budget stated in the migration. The nineteenth section costs about £0.13–0.15 against a £7.19 average; the real cost is step time, which items in this workstream all push.

evidence-policy/research-findings-reach-only-the-assumption-proposer — findings steer deterministically (boost the ranking of extractions from documents a topic's findings cited, which SectionPolicy's excerpt_keywords already has the shape for) and never cross into the writer as evidence. Explicitly not option C: a finding is model prose over untrusted text and admitting it to the citation channel breaks invariant 1.

evidence-policy/ceiling-filter-runs-after-the-row-cap — push the tier predicate into the query as an IN over the admissible tier names, so the cap counts admissible rows only. Becomes load-bearing the moment exhibits and worker excerpts raise the document count.

evidence-policy/content-may-name-a-source-the-section-never-saw — a separate 'shown' set for the content check. The gap is wider than diagnosed: the tier index filters on work_order_id alone, so a content field can today name a document the run quarantined for being published after the as-of date.

evidence-policy/web-search-refused-on-any-run-that-crosses-midnight — compare the as-of stamp against the run's own commission time rather than wall-clock today. That fixes the midnight case exactly, keeps ADR 0092's rule absolute for a genuinely back-dated run, needs no amendment, and is one comparison. Surface the refusal on the run page either way.

segments-guidance/named-peers-never-reach-the-document — a peer listing in industry_landscape's pack with names, identifiers and confirmed rationales, and no footnote: only three citation kinds exist and ADR 0074 forbids a fourth, so an approval is not a citation. Target present-unsourced, which is where two of three console judges scored the same item.

segments-guidance/the-10k-competition-section-loses-its-slots — Item 8 into the 10-K excerpt regions (mechanism (a), certain from the code). Demote the per-item reservation to "measure first": `_score` counts distinct terms and ties break by ascending document position, which favours Item 1, so the asserted crowding runs backwards.

segments-guidance/the-segment-sweeps-own-losses-are-invisible — route the sweep's unmapped counts and leading tags to the coverage notice and the unmapped page as a separate, non-blocking block, and count the multi-axis skips. Every audited subject loses the large majority of its dimensioned tags.
workstreams.exitCriterion: On the re-measurement round: every focus question is answered "yes" or "partly" by 3 of 3 judges on every platform document, with at least one outright "yes" per document (September: 1 yes, 17 partly, 9 no across 27); no comparison's decisive field cites staleness; "management guidance or outlook" scores present-sourced in at least 2 of 3 reads; and at least one section's footnotes resolve to an excerpt of a worker-fetched or exhibit document that replay re-verifies by hash.
workstreams.effort: 16 sessions plus two ADRs (0123 the accession, 0124 the tier ceiling)

workstreams.name: G — The document argues rather than describes
workstreams.whyItMatters: The judges did not prefer a better-researched document — the console's is worse sourced by their own account, with an arithmetic slip, a blog balance sheet and 13 of 46 dead links. They preferred a document that reaches somewhere. The platform cannot: `aer/calc/bridge.py` (a tested, mutation-hardened margin decomposition) has no production caller, `create_scenario` and `set_override` have no caller in src/, and prompt rule 1 correctly forbids the writer deriving anything it was not shown. This is the workstream that is genuinely about ISSUE 2 and nothing else, and it must come after the writers can see the record, or it is calibrated on a starved pack.
items: prose/analysis-computes-levels-never-movements — wire the existing `margin_bridge` into the analysis pass over consecutive annual periods, then add a contribution-to-growth decomposition with its residual. Both are ordinary traced calculations in aer/calc; nothing moves arithmetic toward the prompt, it moves arithmetic that exists nowhere into the only place it is allowed to be. The market-implied solve is a third, separately-ADR'd piece (0126) and is gated on settling why the valuation could not reach a market capitalisation the run held.

judges/scenario-engine-has-no-production-caller — propose bear/base/bull as assumption overrides at the existing assumptions gate, resolve each as a diff, value under each, render the outputs with the overridden inputs beside them. The machinery, the models, the resolver and the scenario_bridge chart builder all exist and nothing creates a Scenario. ADR 0129 settles §8 item 8 — what a scenario holds fixed — and prints the answer on the row.

prose/no-synthesis-pass — a second draft wave: the analytical sections first, then executive_summary, investment_thesis and key_risks with the drafted sections' own recorded claims in their pack, naming claim ids exactly as they name fact ids. Plus a closing section seeded as a definition row. ADR 0125 must state why a drafted claim handed back as evidence is not the model laundering its own prose — the claim-id guard is the decision, not an implementation note.

view/thesis-is-unanchored-and-unchecked — a SectionAugmenter for investment_thesis in ADR 0063's shape: `build` renders the view's figure block from the ledger, `note` tells the writer what it carries, `what_would_change_the_view` becomes required. Ship build+note+required first (one to two sessions); add the refusing `check` only if a live run still contradicts the block, and scope it to a fixed absence-phrase list rather than open negation detection.

judges/sections-write-about-the-evidence-not-the-company — scale a section's drafting budget to its evidence on a second axis beside the existing depth scaling; extend the process-language register to catch researcher-directed advice; and distinguish "not disclosed by the issuer" from "not retrieved for this run" by giving the writer the list of documents the run selected and did not fetch. The wording fix must reach the requires_primary banner text too.

prose/gap-rule-catches-phrasing-not-behaviour — a declared, platform-filled "What this section could not establish" field per section, rendered once at the end, with absence forbidden in the body. Stop trying to catch a behavioural property with a nineteen-phrase lexical list that matches 1% of sentences while roughly a tenth of the prose is about absence. ADR superseding ADR 0100's mechanism while keeping its finding; must show the skill composer keeps the new field additive-only (invariant 7).

prose/numeral-rule-refuses-argument-carrying-sentences — extend the erasers, never the exemptions: a hyphenated alphanumeric designator (FPI-2059) and a bounded run of intervening words between an existing temporal anchor and a year ("by the end of 2030"). One-way narrowings of what is scanned; a genuine quantity is still refused. The cheapest item in the plan and it directly buys back specificity.

prose/salvage-decapitates-and-deparagraphs — preserve the paragraph separator and stop removing the last sentence of the longest field, which in a research paragraph is the conclusion. Ship the separator-preserving split and the changed cut (an hour); the prose-block contract across every commentary field is a separate, later item. The replacement cut rule needs a stated fallback or the loop does not terminate.

segments-guidance/the-two-sections-that-carry-this-material-are-on-the-cheap-writer — measure after the evidence lands: rehearse segment_analysis and industry_landscape on both routes against the identical enriched pack and let the cost delta and one judge read decide. Needs a live_llm comparison, which is real spend and should be named as such.

prose/word-budgets-uniform-and-the-experiment-unanswered — answer migration 0045's question with the three runs that have now answered it (the overruns rescaled from 1.46x to about 1.32x), make the stated ceiling and the enforced ceiling the same number, and reallocate by argument load. Last in the workstream, because a reallocation calibrated on today's starved packs is calibrated on the wrong document.
workstreams.exitCriterion: On the re-measurement round: "are the numbers explained?" scores yes from 3 of 3 on both subjects (September: no on MSFT 3 of 3); "a bear case with a number attached" scores present-sourced in 3 of 3 reads on both subjects; the report prints a bear, base and bull value per share with the inputs changed for each and the bear below the base; and at least one section contains a sentence of the form "operating margin moved N basis points, of which X was gross margin and Y was operating expenses", every numeral footnoted to a recorded calculation and re-executed by replay with zero divergence.
workstreams.effort: 14 sessions plus three ADRs (0125 synthesis evidence, 0129 what a scenario holds fixed, and the ADR 0100 supersession; 0126 only if the market-implied solve is taken)

workstreams.name: H — Whose view the report states
workstreams.whyItMatters: Eight of nine comparisons named the absent view in the decisive field, and the msft1 operator judge's answer to what the console has that the platform lacks was one word: "A decision." But AZN #2 scored view_stated 3/3 and argued 3/3 and still lost 3/3, so this is provably necessary and provably not sufficient — which is exactly why it is a small, late workstream and not the headline. The header line is a literal `None` assigned unconditionally at vertical_slice_v1.py:3765, and the honest fix is not a rating the platform produces but a view the operator holds.
items: view/rating-is-hardcoded-null / journey/no-view-ever-stated / prose/no-stated-view-exists / roadmap/stated-view-has-no-roadmap-item — four ids for one defect. Interim, free, and shipped with workstream C: stop printing a fallback that claims deliberation; where a base-case valuation exists print the composed range and method, where none exists print the value step's own recorded reason.

view/operator-cannot-state-a-view-at-approval — the compliant answer: after approval the run offers "state your view", prefilled from the thesis statement and `what_would_change_the_view`, edited or discarded by the operator, stored through services/theses.py with the report id (ADR 0102's judgements supertype already carries holder, two clocks, a NOT NULL basis, supersession and withdrawal-with-reason), rendered in the report as theirs and dated. ADR 0118.
view/header-contradicts-its-own-body — close it from the header end; land it in the same commit. Three test files pin "no view reached", not two.

view/confidence-must-not-become-a-models-number — decide this BEFORE the view work lands, not after: retire `confidence` from every rendered surface unless it is attached to a judgement with a holder, a time and a basis. Invert the dependency the diagnosis states.

NEW-adjacent constraint: `reports.rating` is String(32). A thesis statement does not fit. Either the column widens in ADR 0118's migration or the header reads from `theses` and the column stays a short label — a schema decision nobody in the diagnosis made.
workstreams.exitCriterion: A complete run ends with the operator's own view on the document, dated and with a basis; no rendered surface prints "no view reached" or "No conclusion produced" for a run that produced a valuation; no surface prints a percentage confidence no person stated; and the next run against the same company shows it as the prior view rather than a blank. On the round, the header and the thesis section never disagree.

workstreams.name: I — Measurement and instruments
workstreams.whyItMatters: The audit's practical verdict — the only instrument that can tell the operator whether ISSUE 2 is fixed — exists in the repository as its output and not as code. ISSUE 1 has no instrument at all. Without both, the round after this work is either a £60 repeat or a declaration of victory from mechanical scorers, which is exactly the trap §4.1 sprang: every mechanical check passed the documents six judges refused to act on.
items: measure/pre-registered-targets — the target document, committed at a hash predating the first paid run, with every September value beside every threshold and the anti-gaming clause (every run commissioned inside the window is judged; none is discarded for reading badly).

measure/judging-harness-is-not-in-the-repository — audit/judging/ with the rubric lifted verbatim from reads.json as data: the fourteen read keys, the nine comparison keys, the ten checklist items, the three lenses. Neutral-path serving first (both documents copied to A.md and B.md under one directory) — the September console note sat at a path containing the word `baseline`, so the blind cannot be demonstrated.

measure/the-blind-is-nominal-so-record-the-guess — one rubric key, `which_was_machine_assembled_and_how_you_knew`, and the hit rate reported beside the verdict; strip the console note's chat preamble as a declared normalisation. Treat September as blinding-unverified, which is the weaker and true claim.

measure/journey-harness-on-the-fake-scene — split as the refuter says: the shape numbers come free by extending audit/smoke.py to call `drive(..., screenshots=True)` on the fake scene and asserting over the per-page records screenshots.py already writes; only the click-level half (a labelled forward control on each stopped state, operator actions counted front page to rendered report) needs tests/e2e/journey.py. Must be red on today's tree, or it is measuring nothing.

measure/minutes-are-measured-live-not-in-the-harness — rename the gate-wait field to say it is the driver's, and define one clock number: commission to first surface stating usable figures, computed from step timestamps on the live runs the round already pays for.
measure/issue-2-remeasurement-plan — three platform runs (MSFT ×2, the second doubling as the refresh case and the variance check; AZN ×1), zero new baselines, 18 reads and 9 comparisons.

measure/baselines-reusable-but-the-as-of-cannot-be-pinned — reuse all three September notes and report the asymmetry rather than papering it: a stale console note is a lower bound on the console, so a platform loss against it is conclusive and needs no control. Buy one fresh MSFT baseline (£7.63) only if the platform wins. Do not restore an operator-typed as-of date to make the audit cheaper — reversing ADR 0110 for the convenience of measuring it is the worst reason available.

measure/promote-the-filing-agreement-matcher-advisory — move numerals/facts/match into src/ as a twelfth RUN_TIME metric, advisory, with a mutation corpus that proves it can fail. Budget four to five sessions: the ruff/mypy migration of 1,284 exempted lines (31 errors including PLR0912/PLR0915) is most of the work. ADR 0130. Put the pure classification in eval/ and the artefact read in the service layer.

measure/promote-the-completeness-readout — a coverage readout on the acceptance check and the final gate, built from the run's own rows rather than substring matches over prose. The September scorer scores market_capitalisation true off the sentence "no market capitalisation was available"; treat its output as a defect to correct, not a target to reproduce.

measure/a-reader-verifiability-metric — distinct citation targets and the share of evidence footnotes whose target is a machine endpoint rather than a page a person can open. msft1 resolves 142 footnotes to four distinct URLs, one of them an EODHD API call with its token redacted. Back-tests cleanly on all five committed reports.

measure/variance-scorer-stays-on-demand — keep it in audit/ and run it over the MSFT pair the round already commissions; pre-register the three permitted causes of a differing key, and note that variance.py has no category today separating a confirmed-assumption difference from an arithmetic one.
workstreams.exitCriterion: The pre-registration exists at a commit that predates the first paid run; `uv run python -m audit.judging.read` reproduces the September shape on a committed report with an empty key-set diff; the journey harness is red on today's tree and green on the finished tree; and the round's total spend, read from the costs table and the ledger, lands inside its stated absolute budget.

workstreams.name: J — Guards, hygiene and the roadmap
workstreams.whyItMatters: Two guard gaps can put a wrong number in front of a reader and neither has ever fired; one invariant (cost is metered and capped) can be jointly overshot by construction; and the roadmap — the repository's own authority on scope — contains not one item that closes any part of either issue, so a session working it worst-first will meet none of this plan.
items: integrity-cost/scale-word-discarded-by-the-reading-ladder — carry the scale word as a hint and narrow READINGS when one is present, porting the reader already written and calibrated in audit/scoring/numerals.py. Larger than it looks: `numerals_in` returns a frozenset and three set operations depend on it, so the scan must become position-carrying, in `core/` which is mypy --strict and pure. Amends ADR 0097, whose stated escape hatch does not hold because cited_figure_agreement uses the same ladder.

integrity-cost/fact-backed-claim-never-checked-against-its-fact — widen `_cited_figures` to a UNION over `Claim.financial_fact_id` (nearly free, and the pattern exists two functions away), then check a numeric claim's own statement against the figure it names at draft time, costing the claim rather than the section under ADR 0096. Today the claim's statement lends cover to the content's numerals, which is the circularity invariant 3 exists to break. Amends ADR 0109, not ADR 0060 — 0109 removed the citation requirement from numeric claims and made this strictly more load-bearing. ADR 0128.

integrity-cost/sibling-spend-invisible-inside-a-wave and /cost-rows-lost-when-a-step-breaks-its-session — one fix, two symptoms, and the operator's call because the obvious answer amends ADR 0016. Recommended: reserve the per-call ceiling up front and release the difference, which needs no ADR and which ADRs 0052/0053's per-step estimates already have the inputs for. The diagnosis's preferred option (publish cost on a short-lived session) cannot work as written: `Cost.agent_run_id` FKs an uncommitted `agent_runs` row, so it means publishing `agent_runs` early too.

integrity-cost/schema-rejected-spend-has-no-surface — a "paid for and discarded" figure on the spend page and the run console. Up to 18,706 output tokens a run are metered and summed nowhere. The token half needs no join at all; only the pounds figure does, and that join silently excludes web-search rows.

integrity-cost/audit-chain-is-application-writable — the BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger, mirroring `artefacts_are_immutable` twenty lines away. The two chain-tamper tests and tests/db_cleanup.py must move with it. Honest about its limit against a determined owner; the full guarantee is the separate role migration 0001 asked for, which belongs with the one-machine gate and not here.

integrity-cost/model-route-table-is-unvalidated-free-text — validate a route's model against the price table at the point of edit, and add `Router.unpriced_routes()` beside `unknown_roles()`. Closes F-05 and the settings hole together. Check the import direction first. Correct the record: `agent_runs` has one `effort` column and no `effort_applied`, so F-05's claim that the divergence is auditable overstates what a person can query.

integrity-cost/suite-order-independence-is-unguarded — a nightly scheduled shuffled job with a fresh seed, not a per-push gate. A red nightly is actionable; 35 minutes on every build is how people learn to ignore a job.

integrity-cost/counts-in-the-record-drift and /acquisition-spend-is-off-the-ledger — correct the two stale docstrings, replace the '458 source files' pin with the rule, assert the documented BLOCKING count against the code, and correct cost.py's docstring so it stops describing a `data_api` row nothing writes.

roadmap/no-open-roadmap-item-closes-either-issue and /the-sixteen-s8-decisions-are-in-no-bucket — rewrite the preamble, correct the two stale "next" pointers (§2.1 at :120 and §3.1 at :391, both closed), and enter every workstream of this plan into §2 and §3 with a number, an owner and its ADR requirement. Account for §8.16 explicitly as "not a work item". The repository's rule is that the roadmap is the authority on scope; a plan that lives outside it is a second authority.

roadmap/two-operator-moves-worth-bringing-forward — the WeasyPrint-on-Windows check paired with workstream E (both are about the document a reader is handed), and one bounded concept-map curation sitting ranked by the audit's own recorded extract rows. Both are operator moves already stalled; neither jumps a queue.

roadmap/what-to-leave-alone — write the non-goals paragraph naming Phase 6 and the Decided-against list, and record that the operator's stated view stays inside the non-advice framing render/document.py:76-80 already carries.
workstreams.exitCriterion: A synthetic wrong-scale claim ("$331.8 million" over a stored 331,839,000,000) is refused at the draft rule and reported by the metric, while all five archived runs replay with zero new refusals; a fact-backed claim misstating its fact's value is dropped; N concurrent siblings under a cap that N-1 would exhaust are refused at the right one; a hand-issued UPDATE against audit_events is refused by the database; and every workstream of this plan appears in ROADMAP.md §2 or §3 with a number.
workstreams.effort: 10 sessions plus one ADR (0128), and one more only if the cost-publication option is taken over reservation

order.what: Pre-register everything, before a line of code. Write the target document (workstream I) with every September value beside every threshold. Build and commit the cost-annotated dead-end inventory, derived from §5's findings AND from runs/console.html's own panels. Settle whether the audit's five run databases and artefact store survive — if not, say so in the protocol and budget one seeding run. Extend audit/smoke.py to emit the journey shape numbers from the screenshot scanner it already drives, and confirm it is RED on today's tree.
order.why: A target stated after the result is not a target, and the audit's own §4.1 shows how easy it is to find a dimension that improved. The inventory must exist before the fixes so that each fix turns a named row green; a harness that cannot fail on today's tree proves nothing. Settling the replay-subject question first is what decides whether the rest of the plan costs £34 or £60, so it cannot wait.
order.gatedOn: nothing
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: The bank's revenue and the guard that never fired. Read the archived companyfacts offline and confirm the splice (FY2021 3,825+2,167=5,992; FY2022 5,822+2,357=8,179; FY2023 7,115+2,528=9,643 — exact against reported `Revenues`). Draft ADR 0113. Ship the parse-layer demotion FIRST (the only change that reaches all six surfaces and the seven quarterly findings), then the traced bank sum, the six surface consumers, the sector-keyed front page, and the `assets`/`total_assets` string fix with its service-level test.
order.why: The one blocking finding still open, and a dead end at the level of an entire subject class: no bank produces an approvable report at all. It is also the sharpest correction the diagnosis makes to the audit's own sizing — a calculation-layer fix clears four of eleven findings and gate 2 still refuses, because five of the six surfaces read facts and `analyse_company` builds annual statements only. Second here rather than first only because the pre-registration must predate it.
order.gatedOn: step 1; the offline splice must pass before any code, and ADR 0113 before any commit
order.liveRuns: none — the splice, the eleven findings and the front page all replay from mtb's stored rows

order.what: Recovery and the honest console. The three dead ends (stale approval with its superseding AMENDED decision, the re-measure action, the rejected gate that reports itself as pending), the re-seal action on the gate page, the silent enqueue failure, the LSE refusal at creation with the corrected resolution message, and the knowledge-map corrections. ADRs 0114, 0115, 0116 drafted first.
order.why: This is the workstream's whole argument made concrete: after this step a run that goes wrong can be taken to its next state from the browser, and — decisively for everything after — a document change can be re-scored against a stored run instead of a fresh £7 one. The re-seal action is a prerequisite of the re-measure action, because re-scoring always moves the live payload off the frozen seal; the diagnosis has that dependency the wrong way round.
order.gatedOn: step 1's inventory; ADRs 0114/0115/0116 exist before code
order.liveRuns: none — fixtured runs and the fake scene

order.what: The first live run of the window: M&T Bank, end to end, browser only, no terminal, no rescue. Record the journey numbers, the gate-page word counts, the values hand-typed, and whether `figure_plausibility` scores 0 of 0.
order.why: The one thing steps 2 and 3 cannot prove offline is that a person can actually walk the loop on a subject that has never produced a report. Spending it here rather than at the end means the recovery paths are proved before eight more workstreams depend on them, and a bank reaching an approved report is itself an ISSUE-1 result the operator can bank immediately.
order.gatedOn: steps 2 and 3 green; audit/smoke.py passing on the fake scene
order.liveRuns: one — MTB (NYSE), the residual-income path, the seventh gate

order.what: The loop is walkable: the macro client wired so the risk-free rate stops being typed, the standing equity-risk-premium value in settings (ADR 0117), the unmapped gate banded, the developer vocabulary moved to a neutral module with presentation_integrity extended to catch it, the JSON-500 negotiated to a page, the citation override built, the sector gate's third answer, the first-read links and the eight-minute figure surface, and the runtime estimate corrected to merged intervals.
order.why: Attention is the binding constraint on the whole plan, not machine minutes: 26,392–34,540 words of gate pages and two to five justified values per run is what makes a re-measurement round expensive in the only currency the operator actually spends. Doing it here means every subsequent live run is cheaper to walk and the journey harness's numbers move before the document work starts consuming them.
order.gatedOn: step 3; ADR 0117 drafted; read ADR 0082/0084 first to see whether the acquisition half is already decided
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: The keystone: port F-27's calculation index into gather_evidence so a section writer can see the run's own WACC and value per share, add the front-page figure floor, extend services/consistency.py to Calculation rows and to negative assertions with a blocking check at gate 2, label and reconcile the front-page per-share figure, fill the valuation range columns, fix the two hardcoded prior-comparison strings and `_trim`'s twelve decimal places, and put the composed range in the header where 'no view reached' stood.
order.why: One session's port fixes the single most-cited document defect. The Executive Summary saying 'no valuation output, no discount rate and no peer multiple' eleven lines under a glance block printing WACC 9.3% and $485.29 is not a prose failure — it is a LIMIT 40 with a NULLS LAST ordering, and the fix is already written and tested one layer over in the red team. Everything in workstreams F and G is worth less until the writers can see the number, and every judge who read a report found this first.
order.gatedOn: step 3 (so it can be proved by re-rendering stored runs rather than by a live run)
order.liveRuns: none — re-render msft1 and azn2 from their own records; `aer rehearse-section` on executive_summary at about £0.30 if the replay subjects survive

order.what: The adversarial record: replay `_evidence_index` over AZN #2's stored calculations under post-F-27 code to size the residual hole, then the period adjudicator, materiality requiring a surviving premise, the settlement written back into the appendix before the reseal, one footnote per cited id with its period, the two-block split of source conflicts from adversarial review, structured figure_claims, the withdrawal check, and re-measuring the per-section metrics inside `revise` before the seal. ADR 0122.
order.why: Eight severity-graded accusations against the report's own headline figures, all closed with the same non-answer, is the second thing every judge named and the thing the msft1 operator judge called decisive. It belongs immediately after step 6 because the adjudicator and the consistency check are the same kind of arithmetic and share the same test fixtures, and because the settlement fix is what makes gate 3 a control the reader can see the result of.
order.gatedOn: step 6; ADR 0122; and the free replay that decides whether the adjudicator is a live hole or a closed one
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: The figures: the inserted-versus-held bars count (subject and peer paths), the market-capitalisation WACC weight, market cap / EV / implied up-or-downside as traced calculations on the glance and in the valuation section with the share basis stated, the comps table accepted at the assembler and footnoted to its calculations, the multiples given periods and surfaced labels, the peers named, segment facts admitted to their section by axis, the segment and revenue exhibits re-scoped by company, and the bank's front page and tangible book. ADRs 0119, 0120, 0121.
order.why: Eight of nine comparisons named the missing price; six of six judges said the figures a note is read for are withheld. Every one of these figures already exists as a replayed calculation in the run that declined to print it, so this is the highest judge-visible return per session in the plan — and it needs step 6 first, because a figure the writers still cannot see is a figure the prose will still deny.
order.gatedOn: step 6; the operator's ADR 0030 decision (what may be printed); ADRs 0119/0120/0121 drafted
order.liveRuns: none for the code — every change replays against msft1, azn2 and mtb's stored rows

order.what: Mid-point signal. Re-render MSFT #1 and AZN #2 from their stored records under everything landed so far, run the new judging harness over the re-rendered exports against the existing console notes, and commission one live MSFT run to prove the chain end to end.
order.why: This is the honest answer to the strongest objection to journey-first: that it delays the ISSUE-2 evidence. Steps 6–8 are all offline-provable, so a re-judge of re-rendered documents costs judge tokens and nothing else, and it tells the operator — half way through, not at the end — whether the contradiction, price and figure work is moving the comparison at all. If it is not, the remaining workstreams get re-argued before another £40 is committed.

ADRs 0123, 0124.

It is also where the console's genuine advantage lives, so it is where the ISSUE-2 headroom is.

measurement.issue1Test: The journey harness (extended audit/smoke.py for the shape numbers, tests/e2e/journey.py for the click-level ones) reports, on the finished tree, against a committed inventory that must be RED on today's tree: (a) zero states with no labelled forward control, across every row of the dead-end inventory — today at least three are red by name (stale approval, refused check, rejected gate reported as pending) plus the failed-step `remedy` branch that offers no control at all; (b) zero UUIDs in visible page text — September: 21 in the refresh run's own comparison table; (c) zero pages whose visible text names a shell command — September: the console names `just worker` and a pause message names `aer reseal`; (d) the bank's gate-page word total under 20,000 with every tag still reachable — September: 34,540; (e) values the operator must supply at the assumptions gate at most one — September: 2 on MSFT, 5 on AZN, 3 on the bank; (f) three of three live runs in the measurement window reach an approved, rendered report with no terminal use and no rescue — September: three of six; and (g) a bank reaches an approved, rendered report with figure_plausibility 0 of 0 — September: never, on either attempt. Plus the operator's own pass through §4.4's six by-hand checks with no [B] row failing.
measurement.issue2Test: The blind judge comparison, re-run with the September rubric lifted verbatim into audit/judging/ as data, neutral A.md/B.md paths, a recorded seed for the A/B assignment, and an identity-guess key whose hit rate is reported beside the verdict. Primary: at least 3 of 6 comparisons do NOT choose the console on "which would you hand to a colleague", and at least 2 of 6 choose the platform — September baseline 0 of 9 on every dimension. Secondary, each with its September value: the platform named better on verifiability in at least 4 of 6 (from 0 of 9); would_act_on_it off "no" for at least 2 of 3 judges on at least one platform document (from 0 of 9); every focus question answered "yes" or "partly" by 3 of 3 with at least one outright "yes" per document (from 1 yes, 17 partly, 9 no across 27); "are the numbers explained?" yes 3 of 3 on both subjects (from no on MSFT 3 of 3); "a bear case with a number attached" and "competitive position with named competitors" present in at least 2 of 3 reads each (from absent 6 of 6); minutes_to_check_three_figures at or below 10 in at least 2 of 3 reads (from 10–30); and zero occurrences in any judged document of "Escalated for human decision" or "no view reached". A round in which judges identify the platform document in 8 or 9 of 9 is reported as format-confounded rather than as a clean verdict, and a narrower focus-question-only instrument is run.
measurement.target: ISSUE 1 is fixed when the journey harness reports zero dead ends, zero UUIDs and zero terminal instructions on the finished tree, and three of three live runs in the measurement window — one of them a bank — reach an approved rendered report without a terminal or a rescue. ISSUE 2 is fixed when at least 3 of 6 blind comparisons do not choose the console and at least 2 of 6 choose the platform, with verifiability won in at least 4 of 6 and no focus question scored "no" by any judge. Both against a no-regression floor that must hold: zero contradicted numerals by the audit's own matcher, 100% citation verification, every blocking metric at its threshold, and every run at or under £10. The alternative ISSUE-2 bar the operator may prefer is 4 of 6 comparisons choosing the platform outright; I recommend 3 of 6 because the console's advantage on argument is partly a format-expectation effect this plan does not fully address, and an unreachable bar makes the round uninformative — but the choice must be made in step 1, not after the result is known.
measurement.reRunPlan: Three platform runs and no new baselines. MSFT (NASDAQ) twice, the second commissioned the next UTC day so it doubles as the refresh use case and as the run-to-run variance check at no extra cost; AstraZeneca (NYSE, 20-F) once. The three September console notes are reused: a stale note is a lower bound on the console, so a platform loss against it is conclusive and no freshness control is needed; one fresh MSFT baseline (£7.63) is bought only if the platform wins, and only to check the win survives a same-week comparator. Judging is 18 reads (3 subjects' worth of documents × 3 lenses × 2 sides) and 9 blind comparisons through audit/judging/, at roughly £2.50 per subject-pair. M&T is judged only if the operator wants a bank in the comparison, which adds £8 for the run and £2.50 for the judging and has no console baseline. Before any of it, `uv run python -m audit.smoke` must pass on the fake scene and the UK refusal, and the round's budget is stated as an absolute number the ledger asserts against a reading taken at the protocol's own commit — not as the residue of September's £63.32, because audit/ledger.py reads the platform half live from the costs table and that headroom is a property of the current database rather than a durable fact. Plus one mid-point signal at step 9: re-render MSFT #1 and AZN #2 offline under the landed fixes and judge the exports against the existing notes (£2.50), with one live MSFT run (£8) to prove the chain end to end.
permanentMetrics: filing_agreement — the numeral matcher against the archived filing bytes, promoted from audit/scoring/ into src/aer/eval/ as a twelfth RUN_TIME metric, ADVISORY until its recall is measured by a mutation corpus. It was calibrated to zero on the platform's own reports, so promoted as-is it is a gate that has never been shown capable of failing on the corpus it would gate. Zero model spend, one artefact read, one regex pass.

A headline-figure coverage readout (market capitalisation, EV, P/E, EV/EBITDA, value per share, peer median, segment revenue, guidance, price basis) on the acceptance readout and the final gate — each figure present or withheld with the reason in a reader's words. A readout, never a blocking metric: ADR 0066 settles that withholding can be the right answer. Built from the run's own rows, not from substring matches over rendered prose — the September scorer scores market_capitalisation true off the sentence "no market capitalisation was available".

A reader-verifiability metric over the exported document: distinct citation targets, and the share of evidence footnotes whose target is a machine endpoint or is unopenable at all. msft1 resolves 142 footnotes to four distinct URLs, one an EODHD API call with its token redacted. Deterministic, no network, back-tests on all five committed reports.

self_consistency_of_absence — computed structurally, not lexically: the set of concepts the rendered document publishes as figures (the glance rows carry calculation_id) intersected with the set a section's declared gap field asserts as absent. This requires the declared gap field first, so the dependency runs the opposite way from the diagnosis's stated one.

brief_coverage — focus questions carrying no cited figure anywhere in the document, displayed at gate 2. Not blocking: metrics are scores and never a pause, so the refusal lives in the answers-block emitter.

NOT promoted: the run-to-run variance comparison. It needs two runs of the same subject and one of its inputs is an operator-confirmed assumption, so a "failure" can be the design working. It stays an on-demand instrument in audit/, run over the MSFT pair the round already commissions, with the three permitted causes of a differing key pre-registered.

NOT promoted: a model judge at run time. It cannot be replayed deterministically, it costs money every run, and it would be a model scoring a model's prose. The judge panel stays an occasional acceptance harness under audit/.

operatorDecisions: THE VIEW, and who holds it. Options: (a) the operator states a short non-binding view and a basis at the final gate, stored as an ADR 0102 judgement with holder, time and a NOT NULL basis, mirrored for display; (b) a model authors a rating over the frozen draft; (c) compose it mechanically from the valuation range and a market anchor; (d) delete the header line. RECOMMENDED (a), with (c) as the free interim that ships in step 6 — print the composed range and method where a base-case valuation exists, and the value step's own recorded reason where it does not. Refuse (b): a one-word label with no holder, no time and no stated basis is the closest thing this tool can produce to regulated advice, it is the first entry in RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS, and permitting it through the built-in door while refusing it through the skill door would make invariant 7 a statement about file formats. Note the schema problem nobody in the diagnosis named: reports.rating is String(32), which holds a label and not a sentence.

WHAT MAY BE PRINTED FROM THE PRICE FEED (ADR 0030 route 2). Options: (a) derived figures only — market capitalisation, enterprise value, the multiples, the implied upside or downside — and no quoted close; (b) those plus a "Reference price" line with its provenance; (c) keep withholding. RECOMMENDED (a). Be honest about two things the diagnosis softened: printing a market capitalisation IS the amendment, not a licence-clean move, and market capitalisation over the filed share count gives the reader the price to two decimals anyway — so the real options are (a)/(b) or nothing, and nothing is what produced eight of nine decisive-field complaints. Whichever is chosen, F-28's share basis must be stated on every per-share row in the same commit.

A BANK'S REVENUE (F-24, the one blocking finding still open). Options: (a) withhold first (demote an ASC 606 component at the parse layer when the filer reports a larger out-of-scope revenue line for the same period), then derive the traced sum on top; (b) withhold only; (c) derive only; (d) leave it. RECOMMENDED (a), and the ordering is load-bearing rather than stylistic: `analyse_company` builds annual statements only, so a derivation can never clear the seven quarterly impossible relations and can never on its own unblock gate 2. The definition itself — that a bank's revenue is net interest income plus non-interest income — is yours, and the offline splice over FY2021–FY2023 is the test it must pass before anything ships.

THE TIER CEILING for named sections (§8 item 12). Options: (a) leave every built-in section at T4 and say on the request form and in the coverage notice that this is a filings-only instrument; (b) raise to 5 for the sections whose subject is the outside world — industry, growth outlook, key risks, catalysts, recent developments — keeping min_sources and requires_primary unchanged; (c) raise everywhere a model writes; (d) a per-run operator switch. RECOMMENDED (b), with claim-level tier marking shipped FIRST, not after. The record cuts both ways: the console's news came from CNN, Robinhood, a Substack and btw.media and every judge docked it for exactly that, so (b) takes most of the benefit with little of the cost. Publish a new version row, never an in-place merge — draft_replay reads the pinned policy.

PEER MULTIPLES (§8 item 1). Options: (a) acquire eight peers' companyfacts and price them; (b) drop the multiples from the eighteen-section spine; (c) keep proposing peers, name them, and say the table is structurally empty. RECOMMENDED (c) now and (a) only behind a measured seeding run: run three or four of MSFT's own confirmed peers as ordinary subjects (about £21–30) and re-run MSFT, which settles alignment, ADR 0061 containment, timing and whether the multiples are sane — with the correctness half of the period-alignment fix landed first, and the peer-path bars bug fixed, or the seeding run will appear not to work. The wording is wrong today whatever is decided: "excluded" reads as a verdict on the peers.

THE SECTOR GATE'S THIRD ANSWER (F-26). Options: (a) a closed list of the other profiles plus "no specialist sector" with a mandatory reason, recorded as AMENDED; (b) a single "not this sector" answer falling through to the unclassified mandate; (c) leave it at two. RECOMMENDED (a), narrow — override the decision block in runs/sector.html rather than widening the shared frame, so the other six gates do not acquire an answer they have no meaning for. Amending AWAY from a blocking profile unblocks DCF_FCFF, which is the permissive direction ADR 0029 exists to fence, so it needs the typed reason, the person recorded, and the amendment's own payload hash re-checked at the deep guard.

COST PUBLICATION (§8 item 6, invariant 6). Options: (a) publish each call's cost row on a short-lived session as the call returns, amending ADR 0016; (b) reserve the per-call ceiling up front and release the difference. RECOMMENDED (b), and this reverses the diagnosis's preference for a reason it missed: `Cost.agent_run_id` is a foreign key to an `agent_runs` row that is uncommitted on the step's session, so (a) means publishing agent_runs early too — a materially larger amendment than its one-sentence framing admits. (b) needs no ADR and ADRs 0052/0053's per-step estimates already supply its inputs.

THE ISSUE-2 BAR, chosen in step 1 and not after. Options: (a) 4 of 6 comparisons choose the platform outright; (b) at least split — 3 of 6 do not choose the console and 2 of 6 choose the platform; (c) dimension-wise, where the platform must win verifiability and the focus questions and the console may keep argument and recent developments. RECOMMENDED (b). September was 0 of 9 on every dimension, so (a) is a bar missed by the maximum possible margin and a round that misses it tells the operator nothing about direction.

THE UK PATH (§8 item 14). Options: (a) build it — Companies House wired into acquire, a UK facts parser, a presentation locator, UK SIC prefixes, a point-in-time anchor decision, roughly 7–10 sessions and one or two ADRs; (b) close the dead end (refuse at creation, fix the misleading message, correct the developer docs) and declare the research scope to be SEC filers. RECOMMENDED (b) for this programme. On the honest reading (a) delivers an annual-only, months-late, peerless evidence base for companies whose US-listed compatriots already work — and the missing GBP risk-free rate is NOT the blocker people assume, because this workflow acquires no macro series at all today. Only the operator knows whether their universe is LSE-listed.

SCENARIOS AT THE ASSUMPTIONS GATE. Options: (a) the proposer offers bear and bull override sets with justifications and the operator confirms them at the gate that already exists; (b) an operator-authored scenario editor with no proposal; (c) a second sensitivity grid on operating inputs. RECOMMENDED (a) — there is headroom at that gate (2 values on MSFT, 5 on AZN) and it keeps ADR 0046's propose-and-confirm shape. Settle §8 item 8 at the same time and print it: today a scenario keeps the base WACC while reporting a beta override as argued about, and no reader is told.

A STANDING OPERATOR ASSUMPTION (the equity risk premium). Options: (a) held in settings with its own justification and date, re-proposed into every run and confirmed at the gate like any other; (b) typed fresh with a justification every run, as today. RECOMMENDED (a). It must NOT be stored as a macro observation: ADR 0082 reserves that table for sourced, dated published observations, and an attested figure propagates into a type with no field for it, so a DCF resting on one would reach no shareable surface.

CONFIDENCE, decided BEFORE the view work lands rather than after. Options: (a) retire it from every rendered surface, keeping the column for a future calibration record; (b) admit it only as the operator's own, on the judgement row where it has a holder, a time and a basis; (c) a model writes it. RECOMMENDED (a) or (b), never (c). A reader meeting "Confidence: 62%" in a masthead beside verified figures takes it for a measurement, and nothing measures it.
newAdrs: ADR 0113 — An ASC 606 component is not a total where the filer reports a larger revenue line outside its scope for the same period (a statement about the taxonomy, applied at the parse layer, needing no classification); and a bank's revenue is net interest income plus non-interest income, derived only under a confirmed bank or insurer profile, never overwriting a stated total and never derived from a single present component.

ADR 0114 — A decision may be superseded exactly when the payload it was taken on no longer exists, recorded as AMENDED beside the original rather than replacing it; and what a superseding decision does to the frozen seal.

ADR 0115 — A classification proposed from a filer's industry code may be corrected by the person who confirms it; the correction is the decision, carries a mandatory reason and its own payload hash, sets the mandate, and is disclosed in the report. An amendment to ADR 0029, which the correction must feed as input to mandate resolution rather than bypass.

ADR 0116 — A completed scoring step may be invalidated and re-run on the operator's recorded request, with the audit chain recording who asked; and whether the earlier evaluation rows survive, which reverses or confirms evaluate_run's documented replace-not-append rule.

ADR 0117 — A standing operator assumption is a stored proposal with its own justification and date, re-proposed into every run and confirmed at the gate like any other, never confirmed in advance and never stored as a macro observation. (Check ADR 0082's Decision section first: the acquisition half may already be decided, in which case this ADR covers only the standing value.)

ADR 0118 — The view a report carries is the operator's, stated at approval as a judgement with a holder, a time and a basis that cannot be blank, displayed and never cited; no model and no calculation may write it; and a confidence is the operator's own or is not printed at all.

ADR 0119 — A derived figure from a licensed feed is rendered when the provider's policy permits it and the type still decides: ADR 0034's mechanism kept, ADR 0030's 2026-08-09 amendment finally reaching the render boundary; the shareable comps type carries the confirmed peers' names and rationales; and a per-share figure states what it is per when the request names a depositary listing (F-28).
ADR 0120 — The equity weight in the WACC is the market capitalisation where the run holds one, and book equity with a stated caveat where it does not.

ADR 0121 — An amendment to ADR 0058: a section that wants dimensioned facts selects them explicitly by axis as its own evidence kind, and every dimensioned figure is rendered with its axis and member wherever it is shown. (Mandatory, not optional — section evidence packs are one of the four readers ADR 0058's Decision names.)

ADR 0122 — Code adjudicates a challenge's arithmetic premise and never its argument; materiality follows severity AND a surviving premise; and an approved report contains no undecided challenge. Amends ADR 0039's "materiality follows severity" and extends ADR 0095's briefing scope to require settlement before publication, while leaving "never auto-resolved" untouched.

ADR 0123 — An accession is a set of documents, not one: acquisition fetches a filing's typed exhibits (EX-99 for a current report) at T1 with the index's filed date, bounded and capped; and a figure read from an exhibit's table is not a fact and may not be printed as one.

ADR 0124 — A named section may read secondary reporting, and every claim resting on one says so to the reader. Must state explicitly that requires_primary and min_sources do not move, must be argued against ADR 0111's recorded-versus-evidence tier split, and must say whether it amends ADR 0092's claim that granting web_search moved no trust boundary.

ADR 0125 — A synthesis section is dealt the run's own drafted claims as evidence and may restate a figure only by naming the claim id that already carries its lineage, so a synthesis can introduce no figure the body did not already publish. The claim-id guard is the decision, not an implementation note.

ADR 0128 — An amendment to ADR 0109: a numeric claim naming a fact is checked against that fact's value, and a figure's scale word is part of the figure. (ADR 0109 removed the citation requirement from numeric claims, which makes the missing value check strictly more load-bearing; this is the amendment to 0109, not a new decision beside ADR 0060.)

ADR 0129 — What a scenario holds fixed: whether a scenario overriding beta or the risk-free rate recomputes the WACC, and that the answer is stated on the rendered scenario row. Cites ADR 0028 (a sensitivity grid is eighty-one valuations) as the neighbouring decision.
ADR 0130 — A twelfth run-time metric checks a rendered figure against the filed bytes independently of the platform's own record, and is advisory until its recall is measured.

A supersession of ADR 0100 — a gap is a declared field, not a forbidden sentence; the budget becomes a measurement rather than a refusal, and the composer keeps the new field additive-only under invariant 7.

An amendment note on ADR 0043 — consequences 4 and 5: the segment exhibit is no longer placeholder-only, and the claim that an exhibit's figures already resolve in both notations is withdrawn, because the Markdown notation carries a caption and markers and the judges could not read them.

ADR 0126 — ONLY if the market-implied solve is taken: a market-implied solve is a calculation over an approved cost of capital and a published market capitalisation, never a fair value and never a reverse-engineered opinion. Must sit against ADR 0066 (a figure that is traceable is not thereby possible).

ADR 0131 — ONLY if the unreviewed first read is published: a first read is a type with no approval control, no export and no PDF, and its banner names every step that has not run. Amends ADR 0091's "before a person ever sees the draft" and touches ADR 0087's verdict placement.

NOT NEEDED, and worth recording as such so nobody drafts one: the evidence-cap port (executing a defect class the project has already classified and fixed as F-27), the consistency extension to calculations, the footnote excerpt and inputs (they make invariants 1–3 legible rather than altering them), the peer naming (a confirmed peer's name is the operator's own work, not vendor data), and the sibling-spend reservation if that option is taken over publication.
notDoing: THE UK ACQUISITION PATH (uk/uk-adapter-unwired, uk-facts-need-an-ixbrl-path, uk-citations-need-a-presentation-locator, uk-sic-scheme-mismatch, uk-pit-anchor-differs, uk-peers-and-fulltext-are-edgar-only, uk-identifier-lands-in-the-cik-column, uk-ch-document-format-probe). Seven to ten sessions, one or two ADRs and a live run, for an annual-only, months-late, peerless evidence base. This plan does the cheap half — refuse LSE at creation with zero spend, fix the refusal that calls AstraZeneca "a different company", correct the developer docs that still claim the path exists — and declares the research scope to be SEC filers. Reversible, and the operator's call if their universe is LSE-listed.

PEER ACQUISITION (comps/peers-recorded-by-cik-nothing-fetched, peer-unit-and-listing-traps, p-tbv-and-p-ffo-have-no-denominator). Deferred behind a measured seeding run rather than dropped. The multiples the judges actually asked for — the SUBJECT's P/E and EV/EBITDA — already exist as traced, replayed calculations and are printed in step 8 for nothing. Acquiring eight peers re-creates precisely the condition ADR 0061 was written for and is the one item in the plan that puts another issuer's bytes under the subject's work order.

PHASE 6 — authentication, inbound rate limiting, a production deployment story (A5/A7/A8). "User ready" sounds as if it implies these and does not: the product is one operator, one laptop, one report at a time, and the gate is intent to leave one machine, which neither issue creates.

THE WHOLE DECIDED-AGAINST LIST, and in particular a model-authored rating. The one place these two issues press hardest against it is the view, and this plan settles that in ADR 0118 as the operator's own non-binding judgement rather than letting it drift into a recommendation through the built-in door.

THE CONCURRENCY WORK beyond the free fixes (speed/revise-runs-one-section-at-a-time, draft-fan-out-is-four-not-seven, extract-costs-nine-milliseconds, the-plan-spine-blocks-acquisition). No judge cited latency; the console won on content. Raising DRAFT_FAN_OUT also weakens invariant 6's cap by construction until sibling spend is visible, and moving extract into the planning wave may collapse to ten seconds of benefit once two pending gates in one wave are understood. Revisit after the round.

PUBLISHING THE UNREVIEWED DRAFT as a typed first read (speed/thirteen-minutes-between-a-finished-draft-and-permission-to-read-it). It trades the platform's claim that a person never meets a draft the adversary has not attacked, for a document that is strictly less of a decision document than the one six judges already refused. The read-only preview and summary links in step 5 buy most of the benefit without touching ADR 0091.

QUICK MODE as a product change (speed/quick-mode-exists-and-nobody-has-ever-run-one). Worth one £4 measurement run afterwards, not a workstream now — it is the shortest path to console parity on time and nobody knows what it costs in quality, which makes it an experiment rather than a fix.
A MODEL JUDGE AT RUN TIME. It cannot be replayed, it spends money on every run, and it is a model scoring a model's prose. The judge panel stays an occasional acceptance harness under audit/.

RENAMING THE SIX RECORDED MULTIPLE CALCULATIONS (comps/multiples-are-unnamed-undated-rows, option 2). It moves a replay boundary and would require re-establishing the audit's "3,335 rows replayed with zero divergence" against new code, to solve an evidence-labelling problem that surfacing the already-recorded parameters solves for less.

THE MAGNITUDE-BASED SUBTOTAL HEURISTIC for segment axes. Any company with one segment above half of revenue meets it, so the rule would silently delete the largest genuine segment — inverting `_without_subtotals`'s deliberate property that a wrong drop is a missing bar, never a wrong number.

THE PROSE-BLOCK CONTRACT across every commentary field, and the word-budget reallocation, beyond making the stated ceiling and the enforced ceiling the same number. Both are calibrated on what a writer can see, and calibrating them against today's forty-row keyhole calibrates them against the wrong document.

THE SEPARATE DATABASE ROLE (integrity-cost/audit-chain-is-application-writable, option C). The trigger ships; the full guarantee needs the migration role ADR-less migration 0001 asked for, which belongs with the one-machine gate.

risks.risk: Journey-first delays the only evidence that matters for ISSUE 2. The first blind comparison lands at step 15, and if the document work is not moving the judges, the operator finds out after most of the programme.
risks.mitigation: Step 9 is a mid-point signal bought for £11: re-render MSFT #1 and AZN #2 offline under everything landed in steps 6–8 and judge the exports against the existing console notes. Steps 6, 7 and 8 are all offline-provable by construction, which is what makes that signal affordable. If it shows no movement, the remaining workstreams are re-argued before another £40 is committed.

risks.risk: The re-measure and superseding-decision work touches the approvals model, which IS the audit record. A wrong shape here weakens the thing the platform is best at.
risks.mitigation: ADRs 0114 and 0116 are drafted before any code and must answer two specific questions the diagnosis left open: what a superseding decision does to the frozen seal (recording AMENDED against the live payload does NOT release the FINAL gate, whose expected_hash comes from the seal step), and whether the earlier evaluation rows survive, since evaluations.py:862 DELETEs them by design. Both get containment tests that fail first.

risks.risk: Raising the tier ceiling admits secondary reporting into a platform whose entire claim is that a figure traces to hashed bytes and code confirms the citation. A sceptical judge who spots an unmarked news-backed sentence discounts the whole document — which is exactly what they did to the console.
risks.mitigation: Claim-level tier marking (step 12's evidence-tier item) is a PRECONDITION of the ceiling rise, not a follow-up: the reader must be able to place every paragraph's standing from the page. requires_primary and min_sources do not move, so a section whose only support is secondary still earns its banner, and SourceTier's own rule that T5 is never sole support for a number stays in force. Publish a new version row so a finished run's sections keep the policy they were drafted under.

risks.risk: The bank fix at the parse layer changes what `revenue` means for every filer, not just banks. A demotion rule that fires on a non-bank silently removes a company's revenue line.
risks.mitigation: The FY2021–FY2023 splice is the gate and it must be exact, not approximate: the derived sum must equal the reported `Revenues` to the pound in all three years before anything ships. The demotion predicate is narrow (an ASC 606 component demoted only where the SAME document reports, for the same period and unit, a larger revenue line outside ASC 606's scope) and carries the gap-A62 regression that a period with a stated total still resolves to the total.

risks.risk: The re-measurement round improves nothing measurable, or improves something nobody pre-registered, and the operator is left choosing a flattering dimension after the fact.
risks.mitigation: Step 1's pre-registration is committed at a hash that must predate the first paid commission, with the September value beside every threshold, an anti-gaming clause (every run commissioned inside the window is judged, none discarded for reading badly), and a no-regression floor that must hold regardless of the headline.

risks.risk: The September blind may never have been blind. The console notes sat at a path containing the word `baseline`, and nothing recorded whether the judge saw it — so "nine of nine chose the console" is a result whose instrument is unverified, and the new round would inherit the flaw.
risks.mitigation: Neutral-path serving is the judging harness's first requirement: both documents copied to identically shaped A.md/B.md under one directory before any judge sees a path, with a test asserting neither the word "baseline" nor "report" can reach a judge through a filename. Add the identity-guess rubric key and report the hit rate beside the verdict; a round where judges identify the platform document 8 or 9 times of 9 is reported as format-confounded and a narrower focus-question-only instrument is run.

risks.risk: Live runs in the measurement window strand, as three of six did in September, and the round becomes half a round for the full price.
risks.mitigation: That is workstream A's entire purpose, and step 14 measures it before a penny of the round moves: the journey harness must report zero dead ends and the step-4 bank run must have completed browser-only. Budget one contingency run and say so.

risks.risk: Effort overrun. This is roughly 65 sessions across ten workstreams and seventeen ADRs, driven by one person. A plan that must complete to be worth anything is a plan that will not complete.
risks.mitigation: The order is worst-first and every step is independently shippable and independently valuable: step 2 alone makes banks researchable, step 3 alone stops losing runs, step 6 alone is one session and removes the defect every judge named first. Steps 10 and 11 are the two that can be cut to a smaller version without invalidating the round, and step 13 can slip entirely except for the roadmap rewrite.

risks.risk: Scope drift: this plan lives outside ROADMAP.md, which the repository's own rule makes the authority on scope, so a future session working the roadmap worst-first meets none of it.
risks.mitigation: The roadmap rewrite is a scheduled step (13), not a footnote: every workstream enters §2 or §3 with a number, an owner (operator decision or session work) and its ADR requirement, the two stale "next" pointers are corrected, and §8's sixteen decisions are split into their decision half and their work half and filed.

risks.risk: Several diagnosis items are sized against mechanisms that do not exist: an eval metric cannot stop a run, `evaluate_run` is not model-free, `Cost.agent_run_id` FKs an uncommitted row, and `discover_documents` cannot enumerate an accession. Building to the diagnosis's sizing produces tests that cannot pass and estimates that are two to three times light.
risks.mitigation: Each of these is corrected in the workstream item text above with the mechanism it must actually use, and the affected steps carry the larger estimate. The rule is that any acceptance criterion naming a refusal must also name the code path that refuses.

risks.risk: The scale-word fix lives in `core/`, which is mypy --strict and must stay pure, and requires `numerals_in`'s frozenset return to become position-carrying — touching three set operations in the draft-time rule.
risks.mitigation: Sized as a few sessions rather than one, scoped to the scale hint alone (percent and multiple hints stay out), and protected by the narrowing the diagnosis did not use: `Evidence.figure_values` holds absolute values by design, so narrowing on a scale word cannot regress a fact stored in millions. Acceptance is a synthetic reply fixture plus a clean replay of the five runs, because an archived reply is content-addressed and cannot be edited.

plans.totalEffort: Roughly 65 AI coding sessions plus 17 new ADRs and two amendment notes, spread across 15 steps. At three or four sittings a week that is four to five months; at one a day, about three. The plan is deliberately built so that value lands early and continuously: step 2 (about 4 sessions) makes an entire subject class researchable, step 3 (about 5 sessions) stops runs being destroyed, and step 6 — one session, one query, no ADR — removes the defect every one of the nine judges named first. The heaviest two are step 10 (the brief and the evidence, ~16 sessions) and step 11 (the argument, ~14 sessions), and both can ship in a reduced form without invalidating the measurement round.
firstThreeThings: Write the pre-registration and the cost-annotated dead-end inventory, and settle whether the audit's five run databases survive — before a line of code. One sitting, £0. The targets must predate the work or the round is an exercise in finding a dimension that improved; the inventory must exist before the fixes so each one turns a named row green; and whether `aer replay-draft` can reach those five job ids is what decides whether the rest of this plan costs £34 or £60.

Fix the bank's revenue at the parse layer, and the plausibility guard that has never fired. Confirm the FY2021–FY2023 splice offline against the archived companyfacts (it is exact — 5,992 / 8,179 / 9,643 to the pound), draft ADR 0113, demote the ASC 606 component where the filer reports a larger out-of-scope revenue line, then derive the traced bank sum on top, then change `total_assets` to `assets` in `_figure_scenes` and add the service-level test. About four sessions, £0. This is the one blocking finding still open, the reason no bank produces an approvable report, and — via the turnover check — the only live guard in the system that has never run.

Port F-27's calculation index into `gather_evidence`. One session, no ADR, no spend. `sections/evidence.py:580-588` orders calculations `period_end DESC NULLS LAST` and takes forty rows with no pool and no ranking, while `calc/engine.py:165-169` gives every discount rate and per-share output `period = None` — so the WACC and the value per share the front page prints are cut at the database before any writer sees them. That is why MSFT #1's Executive Summary says "no valuation output, no discount rate and no peer multiple" eleven lines under a table printing WACC 9.3% and $485.29. The fix is already written, reviewed and tested one layer over in `services/red_team.py:343-374`, and it is the cheapest change in the entire plan that a judge would notice.

plans.thesis: Fixing these two issues means making the platform's own document do a reader's job, and making its own interface finish a job without a terminal — but the binding constraint is neither of those. It is that the audit cost £63.32 and five weeks of context to produce one verdict, and produced it with a hand-built instrument that exists only as its output: the judges' rubric survives as a 497KB JSON file, the journey was counted by hand from screenshots, the "gate waits" are the driver's polling intervals rather than a person's minutes, and eleven items in this diagnosis carry acceptance criteria that cannot be evaluated against any mechanism the platform actually has ("the run stops at gate 2" — but `_validate`'s own docstring at vertical_slice_v1.py:1658 says the evaluation rows are "scores, never a pause"). A programme of ninety fixes measured once at the end teaches one bit. So this plan is organised around one idea: build the permanent instrument first — journey assertions that run offline for nothing, the audit's scorers promoted to run-time metrics, and the blind judge panel as reusable code with pre-registered targets — then fix in tranches, each closed by a re-measurement that costs £31.50 and a command rather than a month. The argument that this pays for itself is arithmetic: the instrument costs about fourteen sessions and £7.50 of live spend (re-judging documents that already exist), ISSUE 1 turns out to be almost entirely measurable at £0 because the fake scene drives the whole workflow with no network and no model spend, and every one of the four formal measurement rounds after that buys attribution — which tranche moved which number — that a single end-of-programme run cannot buy at any price.

workstreams.name: F3 — A reader outside the interface can check it (ISSUE 2, tranche B)
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the most surprising result in the record and the one dimension the platform should win outright: 259 of 259 citations verified, 3,335 calculation rows replayed with zero divergence, every artefact hashed — and the platform won verifiability in none of nine comparisons, with checking measurably slower (10-30 minutes against 10-15). The cause is that the renderer's footnote builder carries strictly less than the database holds: document.py:742-800 emits no excerpt and no locator though citations.excerpt is the very thing aer.verify.citations re-reads, and no calculation inputs though Calculation.inputs is a JSONB array whose own module docstring says a calculation without its inputs "is not a partial record, it is an unusable one". msft1 carries 142 footnotes with 70 distinct texts, forty of them the same companyfacts URL. It is the cheapest large win on the board and the one dimension where a fix is uncontested by any judge's taste.
