workstreams.exitCriterion: A live MSFT run's merged step time is ≤22 minutes against 32.4 today, `revise` is under 300s, a readable document exists on screen when `draft` finishes, the console at ten minutes shows the latest period's revenue, net income and EPS with resolving footnote markers, and the gate-1 estimate is within 10% in words. The operator is asked for attention three times rather than six.

workstreams.name: F9 — Guards, money and hygiene (invariant integrity)
workstreams.whyItMatters: None of this is a defect a judge would see and two pieces of it are invariant 6's own failure mode. Inside the five-node research wave and the four-wide draft fan-out, each sibling's budget guard reads a total that excludes every other sibling's spend, so N calls each individually under the cap can jointly cross it — and CLAUDE.md's own words are that caps that only warn are caps that do not work. A step that poisons its session or dies loses the cost rows it flushed, and those rows ARE the cap. Up to 18,706 output tokens a run are paid for and discarded with no surface summing them. And the audit chain — the platform's integrity story — is append-only by convention: UPDATE and DELETE were never revoked and the application owns its own schema.
items: integrity-cost/sibling-spend-invisible-inside-a-wave + integrity-cost/cost-rows-lost-when-a-step-breaks-its-session + roadmap/cost-publication-and-sibling-spend — one fix, three symptoms: publish money when it is spent. Note the blocker the diagnosis missed — Cost.agent_run_id FKs an uncommitted agent_runs row, so the amendment must cover publishing agent_runs early too; ADR 0016's "nothing commits inside a step" is already false at vertical_slice_v1.py:3145-3152

integrity-cost/schema-rejected-spend-has-no-surface — the discarded-token count needs no join (spend_summary already loads the AgentRun rows); only the pounds figure needs the join, which silently excludes web-search rows

integrity-cost/model-route-table-is-unvalidated-free-text — validate the route's model against the price table at the point of edit, sited in services/configuration._coerce or Router.unpriced_routes() to keep the import direction clean; retire effort on the four Haiku routes; correct the audit's claim that agent_runs records effort_applied — it does not

integrity-cost/audit-chain-is-application-writable — a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger mirroring artefacts_are_immutable; budget the two test rewrites (test_db_schema.py:414-448 issues literal UPDATE and DELETE to prove detection) and the db_cleanup.py exception; be honest in the ADR that it stops a stray write, not an owner
integrity-cost/suite-order-independence-is-unguarded — a nightly shuffled CI job with a fresh seed, non-blocking for pushes; prove it red against the pre-fix commit

integrity-cost/acquisition-spend-is-off-the-ledger — documentation only: correct cost.py's docstring, state the rule (a per-call fee is metered; a subscription and a free endpoint are not), keep DATA_API reserved with its first intended writer named
workstreams.exitCriterion: A fake-provider run with max_parallel=5 and a tight cap stops at the cap with the run's costs total at or under it; a killed step leaves its rows behind; the spend page reports discarded spend matching §3.3's table; an unknown model is refused at the settings page; hand-issued UPDATE and DELETE against audit_events are refused; and the nightly shuffled job is green on a seed nobody has run.

measurement.issue1Test: var/journey.json, written by the offline harness on the fake scene at £0 and asserted in CI, reports: (a) zero states in the committed dead-end inventory with no labelled forward control; (b) zero UUIDs and zero CLI commands in the visible text of every page the journey visits; (c) the unmapped-concepts page's first screen under twenty rows with both counts named and every tag still reachable; (d) three sittings and at most one hand-typed value on a US filer. Plus the live half: three of three runs commissioned inside the final measurement window reach an approved, rendered report driven through the browser alone — no terminal, no rescue, no script — against three of six in September; and the operator walks §4.4's six by-hand checks with no blocker.
measurement.issue2Test: The blind judge panel, run as code from audit/judging/ with the rubric lifted verbatim from judges/reads.json, neutral identically-shaped A.md/B.md paths, seeded A/B assignment, a recorded identity guess with its hit rate reported, and the console preamble stripped as a declared one-sided normalisation. MSFT and AZN against the reused September console notes and MTB against its own; 24 reads and 12 comparisons in the final round. The panel is calibrated first against September's committed corpus and must reproduce the recorded verdict before any later round is believed. Stronger than the September instrument in three respects — it is reproducible, the blind is verified rather than assumed, and each round carries a discriminating pair where the three lenses should disagree; if they never do, the panel is reported as one opinion sampled three times and the operator's own read carries the weight.
measurement.target: ISSUE 2 is fixed when, on the final pre-registered round: (1) no comparison dimension is lost 6-0 — today all six are lost 9-0; (2) the platform is named better on verifiability in at least 4 of 6 comparisons — today 0 of 9; (3) at least 4 of 6 comparisons name the platform on "better answers the brief" — today 0 of 9, with 3 of 6 ("at least split") available as the operator's alternative bar, chosen in step 1 and not after; (4) on every platform document at least 2 of 3 judges move off "no" on would_act_on_it — today 0 of 9; (5) every focus question scores yes or partly from 3 of 3, with at least one outright yes per document — today 1 outright yes across 27 answers; (6) no judge's first_thing_to_check names an internal contradiction, a missing price or the front-page headline; and (7) nothing technical regresses — 0 contradicted numerals by the promoted matcher, 100% citation verification, every blocking metric at its threshold, every run at or under £10, and merged step time at or under 40 minutes. ISSUE 1 is fixed when the journey harness is green on every inventory row, zero UUIDs and zero CLI commands appear in visible text, and three of three live runs reach an approved rendered report with no terminal and no rescue. Note one target deliberately excluded from the bar and moved to the no-regression list: "an investment view is stated and argued by 3 of 3" is already met on azn2 and cannot signal a fix.
permanentMetrics: filing_agreement — the numeral matcher against the archived companyfacts bytes, moved into src/aer/eval/ with its artefact read in the service layer; advisory, never blocking, until a mutation corpus reports its recall as a number

the completeness readout — nine named headline figures present or withheld with a reader's reason, built from the run's own calculation, fact and step-output rows and not from substring matches over prose; a readout on the final gate, never a blocking metric, because ADR 0066 settled that withholding can be the right answer

reader_verifiability — distinct citation targets, the share whose target is openable at all, and the share that is a machine endpoint; the only instrument that would say whether an export fix reached a reader
view_stated — the header carries a view and, where a per-share output exists, a target and its basis
figure_agreement_across_sections — NOT an eval metric: a blocking check routed through the FINAL gate's evidence rule, because an eval row is a score and never a pause
brief_coverage — focus questions carrying no cited figure anywhere in the document; a gate-2 display, with the refusal living in the answers-block emitter
self_consistency_of_absence — structural over the declared gap field, sequenced after it, never a phrase list

Explicitly not promoted: the run-to-run variance comparison (it needs two runs and one of its inputs is an operator-confirmed assumption, so a failure can be the design working — it stays on demand in audit/), and any model judge at run time (it cannot be replayed deterministically and would spend money on every run)
measurement.reRunPlan: Five measurement events. Round 0, the calibration: re-judge September's committed corpus with the coded panel, no runs, £7.50 — and if it does not reproduce the recorded verdict, stop and fix the panel. Round 1, after the document-agreement and export tranches: MSFT ×2 (the second is the refresh case and gives the variance check free) and AZN ×1 at a budgeted £8 each, all three September console notes reused, 18 reads and 9 comparisons at about £2.50 a subject-pair — £31.50. Round 2, after the brief-and-evidence and figures tranches: identical shape, £31.50. The final round, after the bank and prose tranches: MSFT ×2, AZN ×1 and MTB ×1 (judged for the first time), 24 reads and 12 comparisons, £42, plus one fresh MSFT console baseline at £7.63 bought only if the platform has already won — because a stale console note is a lower bound on the console, so a loss against it is conclusive and a win is not. Three £8 single-run confirmations sit outside the rounds: one at the end of the ISSUE-1 tranche driven through the browser alone, one on MTB, one on the speed tranche, plus a £4 quick-mode run. Pre-registered anti-gaming clause: every run commissioned inside a measurement window is judged, and none is discarded for reading badly. Budget discipline: each round's absolute figure is named in the protocol and asserted by audit/ledger.py against a reading taken at the protocol's own commit; a round that would breach refuses to start.

operatorDecisions: Whose view does a report state, and in what vocabulary? Options: (a) the operator's own, stated at gate 2 as a judgement with a holder, a time, a NOT-NULL basis and falsifiers, stored through services/theses.py under ADR 0102 and mirrored to a short label in reports.rating; (b) a model-authored rating over the frozen draft; (c) a mechanically derived band; (d) delete the header line. RECOMMEND (a). It is the only option that does not put a label with no holder, no time and no stated basis on a shareable surface — which is precisely what RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS and ADR 0074 exist to keep out, and the closest thing this tool could produce to regulated advice. Decide `reports.confidence` in the same ADR: retire it from the masthead, or admit it only as the operator's own on the judgement row. Never a model's.

What is a bank's revenue? Options: (a) withhold — demote an ASC 606 component to its raw tag when the filer reports a larger revenue line outside ASC 606's scope for the same period, one edit at the parse layer; (b) derive — revenue = net interest income + non-interest income, gated on a confirmed bank profile; (c) leave it. RECOMMEND (a) THEN (b), in that order, and the order is load-bearing: only (a) reaches gate 2, because seven of the eleven impossible relations are quarterly and analyse_company builds annual statements only. The definition is already verified offline against the archived companyfacts — FY2021-23 splice exactly — so the ADR can cite three reproduced years rather than one data point.

Peer multiples, or no peer multiples? Options: (a) acquire eight peers' companyfacts and price them (ADR 0059's third amendment); (b) drop the multiples from the spine; (c) keep proposing and reword the disclosure honestly. RECOMMEND: (c)'s wording immediately and unconditionally — "excluded" reads as a verdict on the peers and is wrong today whatever is decided — then spend about £29 seeding three peers as ordinary subjects before committing to (a). That settles alignment, containment, timing and multiple sanity with real data, and it produces the first comps table the platform has built. Write the expected outcome down before paying.

May a market capitalisation, an enterprise value and an implied up-or-downside be printed in a shared report, and separately, may the quoted close? Printing the derived figures IS itself the ADR 0030 amendment, not a licence-clean move — the open question is not only the raw close. RECOMMEND: print the derived figures and re-weight the WACC on market equity; do not print the close, noting honestly that a market capitalisation over the filed share count gives the reader the price to two decimals anyway, so the choice is between printing it and printing neither, and printing neither is what produced this finding.

Raise the T5 evidence ceiling for named outward-facing sections? RECOMMEND yes — recent developments, catalysts, industry and growth outlook — by publishing new definition-version rows, never by an in-place policy merge (which retroactively changes the policy a finished run's section was drafted under, and draft_replay reads the pinned policy). Two conditions: claim-level tier marking ships first, and requires_primary and min_sources do not move. Argue it on AZN, where the console's patent-expiry answer rests on trade secondary sources; not on MSFT, where the exhibit fix makes the material T1 and this decision irrelevant to it.

The programme budget. The original £100 ceiling is £63.32 spent with £36.68 left, which is not a durable fact — audit/ledger.py reads the platform half live from the costs table. RECOMMEND raising CEILING_GBP once, explicitly, to £190, with £144.50 of it committed to measurement, £29 contingent on the peer decision and the remainder headroom; and having the protocol assert each round's absolute figure against a reading taken at its own commit.

The ISSUE-2 bar: win outright (4 of 6 comparisons on "better answers the brief") or at least split (3 of 6)? RECOMMEND 4 of 6 on that dimension plus 4 of 6 on verifiability, with the other four dimensions reported but not gated — because a platform that answers the brief better and still loses on argument is a different problem from one that loses everywhere. Whichever is chosen, choose it in step 1 and not after the result is known.

The UK path: build it, or declare the scope? RECOMMEND declare — the platform researches a filer with the SEC, which means any US listing and a UK plc with a 20-F — and close F-04 with the two cheap refusal fixes in step 6. Run the £0 Companies House format probe so the decision is informed rather than assumed (nothing in the repository establishes whether a listed plc's accounts arrive as inline XBRL or a PDF), and reopen §8.14 only if the operator's own universe is LSE-listed. The full path is seven to ten sessions, two ADRs and a live key, and delivers an annual-only, months-late, peerless evidence base.

The sector gate's third answer. RECOMMEND build it, narrow: override the decision block in runs/sector.html only, never in the shared _gate.html, so the other six gates do not acquire an answer they have no meaning for; scope it to the four profiles that block a model; record Decision.AMENDED with the corrected payload and its OWN hash, re-checked at the deep guard, or the hash check becomes a silent hole in exactly the permissive path the ADR exists to fence.

The two new figure guards — refusals or advisories? RECOMMEND both as claim-level refusals under ADR 0096's disposition (the claim is malformed and dropped, which withdraws its cover before the numeral rule runs), never as run-blockers; and replay the five archived runs first to report the refusal count each rule would have caused. The writers were faithful on five runs, so the expected count is zero and anything else is a finding in itself.

Publish an unreviewed "first read" before the adversary has run? RECOMMEND no. Shrink the silence instead — concurrent revise takes the 13-14 minute window to 7-8 — and note plainly that a typed first read has no verdict and no revision, so it is strictly less of a decision document than the one six judges already refused. Its value would be that the operator can stop waiting, not that it competes with the console.

Standing assumptions. Every run makes the operator hand-type a risk-free rate and an equity risk premium with a written justification, while a complete, licence-cleared macro stack sits with no caller in src/. RECOMMEND: wire MacroClient into ServiceBundle and acquire the currency's risk-free series as a derived, dated, sourced assumption (read ADR 0082/0084 first — the acquisition shape may already be decided); hold the equity risk premium as a standing operator proposal in settings, re-proposed and confirmed at the gate every run, and never in macro_observations, which ADR 0082 reserves for sourced published observations.
newAdrs: A reconciliation pass owns the assembled document: no approved report may contain one figure name and period at two values, a sentence asserting a figure is unavailable that another section prints, or an undecided challenge — extending ADR 0095's briefing scope to require settlement before publication, and saying why rewriting differs from the revising ADR 0098 governs.

The view a report carries is the operator's, stated at approval as a judgement with a holder, a time, a basis that cannot be blank and its falsifiers; no model and no calculation writes it; a confidence is the operator's or is not printed — against ADR 0074, ADR 0087 and the RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS rule, which must be shown to stand unchanged.

Code adjudicates a challenge's arithmetic premise and never its argument: materiality follows severity and a surviving premise, and a challenge shown to compare unlike periods raises no banner and buys no redraft — amending ADR 0039's "materiality follows severity".
A figure in a challenge is a reading of a recorded calculation, carried as the id and checked against it, not as a number in a sentence — ADR 0109's claims rule applied to the adversary.

An accession is a set of documents, not one: acquisition fetches a filing's typed exhibits as well as its primary document, which ones, how each is dated and tiered — and what happens to figures that exist only inside an exhibit's untagged tables.

A named section may read secondary reporting, and every claim resting on one says so to the reader: T5 as corroboration, never the sole support for a number; requires_primary and min_sources do not move; published as new definition versions, never as an in-place policy merge. Must say whether it amends ADR 0092's trust-boundary claim or ADR 0111's recorded-versus-evidence tier split.

A dimensioned fact reaches the section that asks for it by axis — an amendment to ADR 0058, mandatory because the Decision names section evidence packs explicitly, carrying the rendering rule that axis and member travel wherever a dimensioned figure is shown.

A derived figure from a licensed feed is rendered when the provider's policy permits it and the type still decides — an amendment to ADR 0034's signature and to ADR 0030's 2026-08-09 determination, recording that a market capitalisation, an enterprise value and an implied up-or-downside are inside it, that a peer name and rationale may be carried, and what the answer is for a quoted close.
The equity weight in the WACC is the market capitalisation where the run holds one, and book equity with a stated caveat where it does not.

A bank's revenue, in two decisions: an ASC 606 component is not a total where the filer reports a larger revenue line outside its scope for the same period (a taxonomy statement, at the parse layer, needing no classification); and, where derived, a bank's revenue is net interest income plus non-interest income for a confirmed bank, with a reported total always winning and a single present component never deriving.

A bank's opening book value is common equity and a per-share appraisal divides by the count in issue at the valuation date rather than the period's weighted average — amending ADR 0070, and stating which equity tag wins before any subtraction, with a migration position for reports produced on the old basis.
What a scenario holds fixed: whether a scenario overriding beta or the risk-free rate recomputes the WACC, and that the answer is stated on the rendered row — beside ADR 0028 and ADR 0046.

Peer acquisition returns now the price feed exists — ADR 0059's third amendment: resolved, fetched, scoped to the peer's own company row under ADR 0061, no excerpt location, no segment sweep, a peer figure never cited in prose, and a foreign private issuer priced as a depositary receipt excluded until a receipt ratio is held.

A decision may be superseded exactly when the payload it was taken on no longer exists, recorded as AMENDED beside the original rather than replacing it — and the record must say what a superseding decision does to the frozen seal, and whether re-scoring replaces the evaluation rows or keeps them.

A classification proposed from a filer's industry code may be corrected by the person who confirms it; a correction towards the permissive answer carries a typed reason, names the person in the mandate, is disclosed in the report, and re-checks its own payload hash at the deep guard — amending ADR 0029.

Money is published when it is spent, not when the step that spent it commits — amending ADR 0016's publication rule, and covering the agent_runs row as well as the cost row, because the foreign key makes them one change.

A standing operator assumption is a stored proposal with its own justification and date, re-proposed into every run and confirmed at the gate like any other, held in settings and never in macro_observations, which ADR 0082 reserves for sourced dated published observations.

A synthesis section is dealt the run's own drafted claims as evidence and may restate a figure only by naming the claim id that already carries its lineage — the closed-world rule extended one layer, against ADR 0087's "never evidence".
A gap is a declared field, not a forbidden sentence — superseding ADR 0100's mechanism while keeping its finding, and showing that the composer keeps the new field additive-only under invariant 7.

A numeric claim is checked against the figure it names, whether fact or calculation, and a figure's scale word is part of the figure — an amendment to ADR 0109 (which removed the citation requirement and thereby made the value check load-bearing) and within ADR 0060 for the scale word.

A twelfth run-time metric checks a rendered figure against the filed bytes independently of the platform's own record, and is advisory until its recall is measured — extending the §2.10 metric vocabulary, which is itself a recorded contract.
A read-only view of a run in progress is not "seeing the draft" in ADR 0091's sense and carries no approval control, no export and no PDF path.

A gate decision may be carried forward for one company while the thing it decided is unchanged, and stops the run the moment it differs by one element — saying what actor and what evidence the pre-cleared approval row carries.

What a citation in an exported document must resolve to for a reader outside the interface, and whether a verbatim excerpt may be copied into an immutable exported artefact given that `aer purge-licensed` exists to delete stored payloads on a terminated subscription — beside ADR 0030, ADR 0031 and ADR 0086.
Append-only is enforced by the database, and what that does and does not guarantee while the application owns its own schema.
notDoing: The UK acquisition path — nine of the twelve UK items. Only the £0 Companies House format probe, the two refusal fixes and the documentation corrections are in. Seven to ten sessions, two ADRs, a live API key and one paid run, to deliver an annual-only, months-late, peerless evidence base for a company class whose US-listed compatriots already work. §8.14 is the operator's to reopen if their own universe is LSE-listed.

Phase 6 — authentication (get_current_user returns the first row of users), inbound rate limiting, a production deployment story. Gated on intent to leave one machine, and neither issue creates that intent. "User ready" for one operator on one laptop is not the same claim as "multi-user ready", and conflating them is how this plan would double in size.

The whole Decided-against list, unchanged: trade execution, a portfolio optimiser, multi-user, investment advice, a positions table, a Bank of England adapter, FCA NSM fetching, an external tracing vendor. In particular a model-written rating, a target_price or fair_value field, and a confidence percentage nobody stated.

A model judge at run time. It cannot be replayed deterministically, it spends money on every run, and it is a model scoring a model's prose. The panel stays an occasional acceptance harness under audit/.

A table-to-rows extractor for untagged filing exhibits. Acquiring EX-99 buys the guidance sentences, the recent-developments prose and the citations; it cannot buy the console's PBP/IC/MPC dollar table or its quarterly margin progression, because those are arithmetic over a table in an HTML press release and covered_figures requires every sound numeric claim to carry a financial_fact_id or a calculation_id. Named as a limit, not scheduled — it would put a parser between untrusted HTML and the fact store and it is the largest unscoped piece of work in the diagnosis.

Publishing an unreviewed first read before the adversary runs. Recommending against rather than deferring: it would be strictly less of a decision document than the one six judges already refused, and it costs ADR 0091's central claim.

Quarterly statement assembly in analyse_company. It is the reason a derived bank revenue cannot clear the seven quarterly plausibility findings, and it is why the withhold-then-derive ordering is load-bearing. Named, not scheduled.
Reopening §3.5-§3.11's judgement layer beyond the one write the operator's stated view needs.

Renaming the six recorded `multiple` calculations. It moves a replay boundary and would require re-establishing the audit's "3,335 rows replayed with zero divergence" claim; the labelling problem is solved by surfacing the parameters already recorded.

Raising DRAFT_FAN_OUT before the sibling-spend fix lands. Three minutes is not worth weakening invariant 6's guarantee by construction, and the bound's own comment records it as a cost-model decision.
Any run-to-run variance metric. It needs two runs, and one of its inputs is an operator-confirmed assumption, so a failure can be the design working.

The magnitude-based subtotal heuristic for segment axes. Any company with one segment above half of revenue meets it, so it would silently delete the largest genuine segment — inverting the property _without_subtotals was built for, that a wrong drop is a missing bar and never a wrong number.

risks.risk: The judge panel is three prompts to one model with a shared prior. Across nine comparisons and six dimensions the vote was 51 console, 3 equal, 0 platform, and on "would you act on it" the three lenses agreed nine times out of nine. That unanimity is either a very strong signal about the documents or an artefact of one opinion sampled three times, and nothing in the record distinguishes them.
risks.mitigation: Include one discriminating pair in every round (the platform's MSFT report against the platform's AZN report) where the lenses should disagree, and check that they do. If they never do, report the panel as one opinion sampled three times and weight the operator's own §4.4 read accordingly — the final round already requires it.

risks.risk: The blind was never verified. The judged paths name a directory called "baseline"; the platform document opens with a metadata block and carries 95 footnotes with git hashes; the console note opens with chat filler. "Chose the console" may partly mean "recognised the house style".
risks.mitigation: Neutral identically-shaped paths served before any judge sees a filename, seeded A/B, a recorded identity guess and a reported hit rate. A round where judges identify the machine-assembled document in 8 or 9 of 9 is reported as format-confounded, not as a clean verdict, and a narrower instrument is run — the three focus-question answers alone, footnote markers stripped.

risks.risk: Most acceptance criteria in the diagnosis are unmeasurable as written. Eleven items propose a refusal through an eval metric, and _validate's own docstring says the rows are "scores, never a pause"; msft2 reached AWAITING_APPROVAL with presentation_integrity failing. A programme built on those criteria would ship checks that cannot stop anything.
risks.mitigation: Step 2 writes the one-page note recording what can actually refuse a run — the FINAL gate's evidence rule at vertical_slice_v1.py:2087, the degradation path, a new blocking check — and every acceptance criterion in this plan names its refusal mechanism before the work starts.

risks.risk: Fixing ninety things and measuring once attributes nothing. The September round proved the shape of this failure: the fixes that produced azn2 changed no verdict, and without attribution it took eighteen fresh reads to find out why.
risks.mitigation: Four measurement events rather than one, with tranches sized so each round tests a single coherent hypothesis, and the pre-registration naming which sub-target each tranche is expected to move. A tranche that moves nothing it predicted is re-cut before the next one is funded.

risks.risk: £144.50 of measurement plus £29 contingent exceeds the original £100 ceiling, and audit/ledger.py reads the platform half live from the costs table — so "£36.68 unspent" is a property of the current database, not a durable fact.
risks.mitigation: Raise CEILING_GBP once, explicitly, in step 1; name each round's absolute budget in the protocol; assert it against a reading taken at the protocol's own commit; refuse a round that would breach. Judge spend goes on the ledger, which September's did not.

risks.risk: Peer acquisition re-creates the exact condition ADR 0061 was written for — eight other issuers' filings under one request, which once put Walmart, Alibaba, eBay, JD.com, MercadoLibre and Target in an Amazon note's evidence. Raising the tier ceiling and admitting segment facts widen the same door from three other directions in the same programme.
risks.mitigation: The standing scope test — every fact and source id in every built-in section's pack resolves to the subject's company_id, to an admissible tier and to an unquarantined document — is written and green before any of the four merges, and it is the test that fails first if one of them widens scope by accident.

risks.risk: The re-measurement compares improved platform runs against September console notes that are months stale on news and prices, on a dimension (recent developments) the platform lost nine times out of nine.
risks.mitigation: Report the asymmetry rather than hide it: name the baseline date, the run date and the filings each side could have read. A stale console note is a lower bound on the console, so a platform loss against it is conclusive and needs no control; a fresh baseline is bought only if the platform wins, and only for the cheapest subject.

risks.risk: Run cost and run time rise as evidence reach improves. The evidence tranche adds exhibit fetches, worker excerpting, a nineteenth section and possibly eight peers; the audit's use case 7 already fails on 31-42 minutes and a 12.5-15.3k-word document, and three separate tranches push that axis.
risks.mitigation: Every round report carries a measured cost line and a merged-interval time line; the £10 cap and a 40-minute merged-step ceiling are stated in the pre-registration as constraints a tranche must not breach; the new section's word budget is a hard number in its migration; and the time tranche is scheduled after the content tranches precisely so it is optimising the real shape.

risks.risk: Two of the plan's cheaper items rest on engine behaviour nobody has established — whether two gate nodes can be schedulable in one wave, and whether evaluate_run can be run without a model call. If either answer is no, the plan-spine change collapses to ten seconds and the re-measurement after revise becomes a carve-out rather than a call.
risks.mitigation: Both are settled offline, before costing, as the first half-hour of their tranches; each is named in the step's gatedOn so the discovery cannot silently inflate a session estimate.

risks.risk: A session reverses a recorded decision by accident, or re-fixes something the audit already fixed. The diagnosis alone contains three items whose recommendation contradicts a decision in an ADR the item never cites.
risks.mitigation: The ADR ledger is written in step 1, before any code; every tranche names the ADRs it amends before it starts; and no tranche whose ADR does not yet exist may begin, which the roadmap entry states as its gating.

risks.risk: The permanent matcher was calibrated to zero on the very reports it would gate, and its recall has never been measured — so promoted as-is it is a metric that has never been shown capable of failing on that corpus.
risks.mitigation: Ship it advisory, never blocking, with a mutation corpus that perturbs k figures by a scale factor, a digit transposition and a period shift and asserts the contradiction count rises with k. The recall is reported as a number, not asserted as a property, and the blocking question is not even asked until that number exists.

risks.risk: The measurement-first sequencing itself is a risk: fourteen sessions and £7.50 pass before a single product defect is fixed, and an operator watching may reasonably ask what they bought.
risks.mitigation: Three of those five steps cost nothing live and produce permanent CI assets rather than audit scaffolding; the ISSUE-1 fix tranche follows immediately and is itself free; and the calibration round is the one place where finding out the instrument is wrong costs one sitting instead of £31.50 and a false conclusion. If the operator wants a visible win first, step 2's four counters and the peer-wording fix are the smallest honest things to pull forward.

plans.totalEffort: ≈ 85-95 AI coding sessions — call it four to five months at one sitting a day, or two to three at two — of which the first 15 build the instrument and cost nothing live. Twelve operator decision points, five measurement events, and 25 new or amended ADRs, four of which gate work that cannot start before they exist.
firstThreeThings: Write the plan where the repository says plans live, and pre-register the targets. Rewrite ROADMAP.md's preamble and its two stale "next" pointers (:120 and :391 both name closed items), open a post-audit §2/§3 block carrying every item here with a number and its ADR requirement, write the non-goals paragraph and the ADR ledger, and commit docs/plan/remeasurement-2026-Q4.md with every threshold in the measurement section and its September value beside it. The commit hash must predate the first paid run — that ordering is the only guard a pre-registration has, and it is available only now.

Fix the four counters that count the wrong thing, in one sitting, for nothing: the turnover guard that queries the concept `total_assets` where the canonical concept is `assets` and has therefore never fired (evaluations.py:612,646 against calc/plausibility.py:119-135); the price step that reports "the provider returned no prices" when it means no new bars were inserted (price_acquisition.py:477 and :208, plus the identical bug at :337), which voids the entire price-derived layer on any warm database and would make every re-measurement round after the first measure a different product; the gate-1 runtime estimate that sums overlapping steps, and the audit scorer that does the same and produced the published "31-42 minutes" against a true merged 26.5-36.8; and the two live docstrings that state counts the code contradicts. Then write the one-page note recording what can actually stop a run, because eleven items in the diagnosis propose refusals through a mechanism that does not exist.

Build tests/e2e/journey.py and the smoke-scene extension against the committed dead-end inventory, and confirm it is RED on today's tree — at least three inventory rows with no forward control, and at least one page whose visible text names a shell command. It runs on the fake scene with no network and no model spend, so the entire ISSUE-1 instrument costs zero pounds; and a harness that comes up green on its first run is measuring nothing, so the red is the deliverable.

plans.framing: Delivery, not capability — the two issues are one issue seen from two sides. I read the ninety verified findings and the dominant pattern is not that the platform lacks the ability to do the thing; it is that the thing it already does never reaches a human. "Not user-ready" is the last-mile gap on the interface; "not better than the console" is the last-mile gap on the document. Same disease, two organs. So this plan is organised around delivery — front-loaded with connections to things already built and tested, with a deliberate measurement gate at roughly forty sessions that tests the thesis before the genuinely expensive acquisition work is committed to. Three claims the product makes should be narrowed rather than defended (speed, news recency, the UK), and one should be defended without compromise (the view, as the operator's own judgement and never a model's).
plans.thesis: The two issues are one issue. Across ninety verified findings the dominant pattern is not missing capability but missing delivery: the platform computes, stores, hashes and verifies far more than it ever shows anybody. It computed MSFT's P/E at 27.43x and EV/EBITDA at 18.93x on every run and `assemble_document`'s comps parameter is typed so that no multiple can pass through it — while the operator's own licence determination of 2026-08-09 already permits derived figures (`fetch/policy.py:176-192`) and `CompsTable.for_audience` (`calc/comps.py:305-323`) already honours it. It holds the verified excerpt its own code re-read to confirm each of 259 citations and prints none of them, which is why the platform lost verifiability 0 of 9 on the dimension it exists for. It stores segment revenue and filters it out of the one section that is about segments. Its scenario engine, its margin bridge, its macro client, its Companies House adapter, its citation override and its one-page summary are complete, tested, and called from nowhere but tests. `reports.rating` has a column, a renderer, an Obsidian export and a planner that consumes it, and one line assigns `None`. The Executive Summary truthfully reports "no valuation output" eleven lines under a front page printing WACC 9.3%, because `sections/evidence.py:580-588` orders calculations `period_end DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40` and every valuation output carries `period = None` — the same defect the audit already fixed for the adversary as F-27 and never fixed for the writers. That reframing is load-bearing because it changes the work: connecting a built thing is an hour to a session, almost none of it touches an invariant, and the arithmetic and evidence rules that would be the risky part already exist and already work. What changes is who is shown the result.

workstreams.name: WS1 — The document must stop disagreeing with itself
workstreams.whyItMatters: Every judge who read a platform report found it saying two incompatible things about a load-bearing figure and shipping severity-5 accusations against its own headline numbers, marked "Escalated for human decision at approval" and never decided. Contradiction appears in the decisive field of 7 of 9 comparisons and self-accusation in 8 of 9. This is a hard prerequisite: every other improvement in this plan lands inside a document a judge has already been told not to trust, and AZN #2 proved that fixing the numbers without fixing the disagreement changes no verdict.

workstreams.name: WS3 — The exported document must be checkable by a reader who only has the file
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the most surprising result in the record and the one the platform should have won outright: 259 of 259 citations verified, 3,335 calculation rows replayed with zero divergence, 559 artefacts re-hashed intact — and the platform won verifiability in none of nine comparisons, with checking measurably slower than the console's. msft1 carries 142 footnotes with 70 distinct texts, 40 of them the same companyfacts URL with no concept, period or value. The audit's own conclusion is that the advantage lives in the interface and not in the document. Fixing that is printing what is already stored, and it is the one dimension where I predict a clean flip.
items: judges/verifiability-lost-in-the-export + journey/exported-footnote-has-no-excerpt — SourceFootnote gains the verified excerpt and the locator (concept, period, unit for an XBRL fact; item and quoted sentence for a filing), using the financial_fact_id and extraction_id sections/render.py:86 already carries; CalculationFootnote gains its inputs by name, value and unit, each with its own marker; de-duplicate on source or calculation identity, never on note text

measure/a-reader-verifiability-metric — count distinct citation targets, the share of evidence footnotes resolving to a machine endpoint, and the share openable at all; back-test against the five committed reports

NEW: a licence rule for printed excerpts — aer purge-licensed exists because a terminated subscription obliges deletion of every stored payload; a verbatim excerpt copied into an immutable exported artefact is a payload copy the purge cannot reach, so the excerpt is printed only for tiers whose licence permits redistribution
workstreams.exitCriterion: On the M1 re-judging, minutes_to_check_three_figures falls to 10 or below in at least 2 of 3 reads and below the console's on the same subject; better_on_verifiability returns the platform in at least 4 of 6 comparisons; no judge's verifiability note says a figure "cannot be located" or "cannot be reproduced from anything in the document"; and the exported Markdown contains no snake_case identifier and no raw Decimal in reader prose.

workstreams.name: WS4 — A view the document can defend, and never a model's
workstreams.whyItMatters: Every report ever produced leads with "Non-binding view: no view reached", and it is a literal None assigned at vertical_slice_v1.py:3765 — not an abstention after deliberation. Eight of nine comparisons name the absent view. But AZN #2 is the counter-evidence that makes this workstream's placement matter: it scored view_stated 3/3 and argued 3/3 and still lost 3/3, so a view is necessary and provably not sufficient. It goes after WS1 and WS2 for that reason, and it is built as the operator's own judgement because that is the only shape that stays inside the invariants and inside the product's non-advice framing.

workstreams.name: WS5 — A bank can be researched
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the one blocking finding the audit left open, and the reason no bank produces an approvable report at all. It is also the cleanest demonstration that a guard gap is a user-facing defect: the plausibility check's third relation has never fired on any run because it queries the concept `total_assets` and the canonical concept is `assets`, so the very run whose 0.0076 asset turnover calibrated the floor was never told. The audit spent £9.64 on two M&T runs for no report.

workstreams.name: WS6 — The operator's path has no dead ends and no terminal
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is ISSUE 1's own workstream and it is a count, not an opinion — which means it can be made into a test. Three true dead ends are documented and unfixed (a stale approval no surface can supersede, a refused check nothing can re-measure on a run that cannot even be superseded, a console that says "Waiting for you" and links to a page with no form). The product tells the operator on the run console to look at the terminal running `just worker`, and names `aer reseal` in a pause message. The assumptions gate makes them hand-type a risk-free rate on every £7 run while a complete, licence-cleared macro stack sits with no caller.

workstreams.name: WS7 — Reach: the evidence that is genuinely absent
workstreams.whyItMatters: This is the only workstream with real new building in it, and the only one gated on operator decisions that change recorded evidence policy. AZN's report, dated 12 September 2026, is built on a record stopping 31 December 2025 because a 20-F filer receives zero interim statements and the five newest 6-Ks are a bond admission and total voting rights notices. The console's entire segment table came from Exhibit 99.1 inside the same accession folder the platform downloaded the cover page from. The operator's focus questions reach the planner and stop. Every one of these is a wiring or selection gap, not an invariant problem — but the tier ceiling and peer acquisition are genuine decisions, and they go behind the M1 gate because M1 may make them unnecessary.

workstreams.name: WS8 — Guards, cost integrity and the record
workstreams.whyItMatters: Two of these are guard gaps on the platform's own strongest claim: a fact-backed numeric claim is never checked against its fact's value (only calculation-backed ones are), and the reading ladder discards the scale word, so "$331.8 million" over a stored 331,839,000,000 passes both the draft rule and the gate-2 metric. The audit's "0 contradicted of 779" is evidence the writers did not make that mistake on five runs, not evidence the platform would catch it — the audit's own scorer reads scale words and the platform's guard does not. The rest is cost and record hygiene with one user-visible seam each.

ISSUE 1 has no instrument at all. And the roadmap — which CLAUDE.md makes the authority on scope — carries none of this: its two live 'next' pointers both name closed items, and §8's decisions exist only as one paragraph of preamble.

order.what: WS1 in full: the document stops disagreeing with itself. Extend consistency.py to calculations and negative assertions, routed through the new blocking check. Make an escalated challenge unpublishable and render the operator's settlement. Replay the adversary's evidence index under current code before building the period adjudicator, then build it and gate materiality on a surviving premise. Fix the front-page per-share label and the header's disagreement with the thesis. Re-measure the deterministic metrics inside revise before the seal.
order.why: This is a hard prerequisite for everything else. AZN #2 proved that real fixes to the numbers change no verdict while the document still tells a reader not to trust its headline figures. Every later improvement lands inside a document the judges have already been instructed to discount. It goes before the view for the same reason: azn2 stated a view, argued it 3/3, and still lost 3/3.
order.gatedOn: steps 2 and 3
order.liveRuns: none — all five stored documents re-assemble offline, and aer replay-draft costs nothing

order.what: WS2 part one: the figures the run already computed reach the page. The assembler accepts a CompsTable and the licence flag decides; calculation ids persisted so each multiple footnotes like the DCF's; HTML and one-pager changed in the same commit. Peer names and rationales into §17 and the industry pack. Market capitalisation, enterprise value and an implied up or downside as traced calculations; the WACC struck on market equity; the share basis named on every per-share row. Valuation range columns filled; the refresh comparison's hardcoded promises replaced; twelve-decimal precision bounded.
order.why: Every figure here already exists as a traced, replayed calculation on runs the audit paid for, and the only thing stopping them is a render signature enforcing a licence position the operator reversed on 2026-08-09. This is the cheapest conversion of 'withheld' into 'present-sourced' available anywhere in the plan, and eight of nine comparisons named the missing price position in the decisive field.
order.gatedOn: step 1's ADR 0030 answer, and step 4
order.liveRuns: none — re-render MSFT #1 and AZN #2 from their stored records

order.what: WS2 part two: segments, exhibits and scenarios. A segment evidence category selected by axis under an ADR 0058 amendment. The exhibit query scoped by company and as-of date rather than by job. Bar labels and a rows field so the Markdown carries each series as a table. IFRS axes added and the alphabetical fallback replaced with an honest placeholder. The scenario engine wired between the assumptions gate and the valuation. The margin bridge wired into the analysis pass.
order.why: Four of these are complete, tested modules with zero production callers; one is a join on job_id where it should be company_id, which silently loses the segment chart on every second run of a company and lost M&T's 182 stored segment rows entirely. 'A bear case with a number attached' and 'segment revenue' are two of the six checklist rows the platform lost, and both are here.
order.gatedOn: step 5
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: WS3: the exported document becomes checkable by a reader who only has the file. Excerpt and locator on every source footnote; inputs with units and their own markers on every calculation footnote; de-duplication on source or calculation identity, never on note text. The one-pager as front matter. Exhibit series as tables. The metric vocabulary moved to a neutral module and the presentation scan extended to catch a bare identifier or a raw Decimal. The licence rule for printed excerpts settled.
order.why: This is the dimension the platform exists for and the one it lost 0 of 9, with checking measurably slower than the console's. Everything printed here is already stored, already hashed, and is literally what the verifier re-read to confirm the citation. It is the item most likely to flip a blind comparison and it needs no decision.
order.gatedOn: step 4
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: WS4: the view. Write the ADR first. Then the operator's judgement at approval, prefilled from the thesis section, stored through services/theses.py with the report id, rendered as theirs with its date, basis and falsifiers; the header composed so it can never deny the thesis; investment_thesis gains its augmenter's build and note and a required falsifier list; the one-pager gains the thesis; confidence is settled.
order.why: Necessary and provably not sufficient, which is exactly why it goes eighth rather than first. It is also the item most at risk of being built the wrong way — a model-written rating is what RESERVED_OUTPUT_FIELDS exists to keep out, and permitting it through the built-in door while refusing it through the skill door would make invariant 7 a statement about file formats.
order.gatedOn: steps 4 and 5 (the header needs a composed range to carry)
order.liveRuns: none

order.what: WS5: a bank can be researched. Run the FY2021–FY2023 splice against the archived companyfacts offline before writing anything. Withhold at the parse layer, then derive on top and move the five fact-reading surfaces. Sector-aware front page. Both residual-income conventions stated on their rows. Book value per share beside the appraised value. The review page given the arguments the render step already supplies. The sector gate's third answer.
order.why: The one blocking finding the audit left open, and the reason no bank produces an approvable report at all. The splice is free and decisive: if the three reported years do not reproduce, the definition is wrong and nothing ships. Only after it passes is a live run worth £7.61.

Two platform runs (MSFT, AZN) against the three reused September console notes; twelve judged reads and six blind comparisons through the new harness with neutral paths, a seeded A/B and the identity guess recorded. Optionally one quick-mode run (£4) to settle what the depth control that has never been exercised actually produces.
order.why: This is where the thesis is tested cheaply, before the expensive workstreams are committed to. If verifiability does not flip here, the plan's organising idea is wrong and the remaining work should be re-planned rather than continued. If the brief and would-act measures move too, most of WS7 becomes optional.
order.gatedOn: steps 4 through 9

order.what: WS6 part one: dead ends and the harness that proves they are gone. Build the inventory from the console templates as well as from §5. Extend audit/smoke.py for the shape counts and add the click-level journey module. Close the assumptions door and open the superseding-decision exit. Add the re-measure action and the re-seal action. Stop a decided gate saying 'Waiting for you'. Band the unmapped gate by materiality.

The re-seal action is a prerequisite for the re-measure action, because re-scoring moves the live payload off the frozen seal.

order.what: WS6 part two: the terminal goes away. The verification page (chain report first; the 559-artefact store walk as a background job). The preflight panel and the run export download. The citation override surface ADR 0018 already decided. The macro client wired and a standing equity risk premium. HTML error pages and honest queue failures. The first-read surfaces linked while a run is RUNNING. Concurrent revise, the merged-interval runtime estimate, and the extract profile.
order.why: The product currently tells the operator on the run console to look at the terminal, and names aer reseal in a pause message. The macro stack is complete and licence-cleared and has no caller, so the operator hand-sources a risk-free rate on every £7 run — and a hand-typed rate is the one number in the valuation with no source behind it, which is precisely what the sceptic judge attacks.

order.liveRuns: none

Select current reports by item code and description rather than by date alone, and admit a foreign private issuer's results 6-K to the periodic set. Recognise an exhibit on the regulator's archive path under an accession the run holds, normalising CIK padding. Excerpt every acquired document whoever acquired it.
order.why: The console's entire segment table and its strongest claim came from a file in the folder the platform already opened. AZN's report is nine months stale at its own as-of date because the five newest 6-Ks are administrative. None of this is an evidence-policy change — it is selection and acquisition, deterministic, and it is where written guidance actually lives.

The tier ceiling raised on named outward-facing sections by a new version row, with claim-level tier marking shipped in the same change. The wording fixes that stop a section blaming the issuer for what the run did not retrieve.
order.why: Across 27 focus-question readings the platform scored 1 yes, 17 partly and 9 no against the console's 6 yes, 21 partly and 0 no, and the operator's own words reach the planner and stop. Passing them to the five agents that hold tools is an hour and multiplies every other reach item. The ceiling is the operator's decision and is deliberately sequenced after the free half, so it can be argued on what is left rather than on what is cheap.

The scale-word hint and the fact-value check, each shown failing on a mutant first and producing zero new refusals across the five archived runs. Route-table validation. Cost reservation or early publication. The discarded-spend figure. The audit-chain trigger. The nightly shuffled job. The salvage and numeral-rule fixes, and migration 0045's unanswered question.
order.why: These defend the platform's one unqualified win rather than extending it, and they can run in parallel with anything. They are placed after M1 because none of them moves a judge, and before M2 because the scale-word guard and the fact-value guard are the two holes in the '0 contradicted of 779' claim the re-measurement is about to quote again.

Three platform runs (MSFT twice, the second doubling as the refresh case and the free variance check; AZN once) against the reused console notes; eighteen judged reads and nine blind comparisons; the journey harness run on the fake scene; the completeness readout, filing_agreement and reader-verifiability figures reported beside the judges' votes. Every run commissioned inside the window is judged and none discarded.
order.why: This is the answer to the operator's question, measured against thresholds fixed before the work started. Three runs also re-prove the reliability claim (3 of 3 reaching an approved rendered report, against 3 of 6) at no extra cost, and the MSFT pair gives the variance comparison free.
